And I do not speak of food, I speak of the wherewithal you call money. You have requested that you have sufficient funding to attend to these needs. And the dear one has released that into our hands. Feel assured that as the time approaches there will be a place for these little ones and they will be enfolded within the circle to fulfill their functions and they will want their own abode and that will be forthcoming. They will need your help.
07:14
They will need our help. But each will soon, in your time, come to carry their own load. It would appear from here that you should just continue as you are. Enjoy the lovely things that have been placed within your experience. Our higher ones wish you to have joy and beauty about you without guilt without the pain of feeling you have more than another.  You have deserved of it and it is with joy we see you enjoy it and believe me it will be even better.  Does this bring comfort? 

[other speaker] Yes, it brings great comfort and we are grateful for that information. I too join the Dear One in requesting appropriate funding and releasing to you.
08:58

[other speaker] We have some... many questions that can be answered straight yes or no, if you wish. 

I have a good tongue.

[other speaker] Are we correct in shutting down the turbine for the rest of this month? 
09:45
Oh yes, yes. You have perceived correctly. The turbine, although you have grown to love it dearly, will not function. It is sad because you do have an attachment to it. Do what you need to do to acquire the data and statistics which you require during this interim period of time, and then put it to rest as much as is possible. [other speaker]  Yes, thank you. Next question? 

Yes.

12:08

Neither is it your requirement to maintain on that level a place.  Your home is your home. Others are to be welcome within it, but you are to live within it. [other speaker] New subject?

All right.

Ah yes.

15:08

[other speaker] Yes I understand and concur. 
16:25

[other speaker]  You've anticipated my next question. 

You're welcome.

Oh, yes. 
[other speaker]  Could you tell us about him?
17:38
Oh, yes.  This one sends chills along the instrument. This energy comes from such a high, high place that I even or rather even I am awed I stand in such reverence Of that energy which has come as Cesar Chavez. It would be that that one in the future will touch you closely.  He will come with such gentleness and such love and such caring that your space will be lighted from his presence. There are those who love him dearly and make every effort to protect him. He is a gentle guide.  Heed his words. Another? 

[other speaker] Yes. Richard Emerson, who stayed with us for a few days recently. 
20:24
Yes, we watched. Precious energy. Searching. Almost finding. Almost grasping. He is able to speak the words, and he will come to believe his own words. But at this time, he is still seeking his physical human attachments.  He has had a painful way, a disoriented way. He thinks he knows of the goal for which he strives, but he has not yet found it. And he wishes to be a follower and that is not fair to the one he follows. For that one, too, is seeking and wishes to follow.  He is seeking his way. He will eventually find it. But he must not be allowed to become comfortable, if you will, in the knowingness of another, and that would include the two of you. There will be a time where in all probability he will participate. It will be from a separate place, perhaps within this area, but his energies will operate from a different dwelling, if you will.  He needs his independence as he is threatened, he is threatened by others being around him and from that input which exudes from them. He will grow into a beautiful, beautiful energy of great contribution to this earth and to the light as grandfather would say, Aho 

[other speaker]  Is current connected one Joyce Nash?

Yes. What would you ask? 

[other speaker]  A discussion of her similar to that of him and whether their relatedness is likely to continue. 
24:15
Joyce is of a beautiful, beautiful creation. She has accepted the path of lifting and pulling others along of being what you might call the foundation from which others function.  She has done this for long and in many places. She must be very, very cautious or she will make the same mistake once more. It is not to say, disjoin yourself from that one of which you have grown so fond if you were speaking with her, but not to form attachments that in her own fundamental makeup system she would find it extremely difficult to sever.  Because it would give her a feeling of being, let us say locked up and then her responsibilities to this other one would cause her to act in a different manner than she would were she not attached in your legal sense.  She has no separation in her legal and her moral obligations.  So if she becomes too entwined, there will be no difference in a legal documented attachment and one which has simply grown and she is in a position where she might be used and I do not use the term, used, unkindly it is not a conscious use of another it is simply that we seek we seek the strength we seek to use the strength of others to fill the naked areas in our own beings and she needs to locate her own space.  She is opening up to know that of which she is and she knows the path she has taken before is not the proper path for her.
But she too must learn to function as an individual standing alone and she is quite willing to do that. She would never become what you would call a burden as a guest in your home. Where the problem might come in considering those who might dwell with you for a lengthy period of time is that the two energies, Doris and EJ, have not come their full educational path to the point where they can allow themselves to be disattached. When ones dwell within your home, at this point it is impossible for you to detach yourself from those energies and function. And you must be open at all times for our contacts.  It will become easier and it will sort itself out. Do not dwell upon the subject. Of course others must come through your lives. You are not expected to live as hermits. And I see the ambiguity of the statements, the hypocrisy if you will, that you should be open and accept and welcome and yet, let us call it discretion and it will become easier. You are here as teachers and leaders and those will come to you for teaching and leading. And they will need guidance. But remember that you are still students. And your education will grow. Be patient.  Your favorite words. Be patient. We will help. We are here to help. And we have accepted your request that we assist. So be it. Is there another? 

[other speaker] Yes, a young man in Glastonbury, England, named Michael Irving. 
30:44
Oh yes, yes. We love Michael.  We love Michael. Michael is a joy. Michael searches here and Michael searches there. As your nursery rhyme, Michael searches everywhere, all he wishes to find his way. And in wishing, he writes off more here and more there than there could possibly ever be consumed. Stay in touch with this delightful energy as he will bring others, not just himself, but he will bring others of great, great importance and input within your circle. Welcome them. And let me say that some of the concerns about what to do with some of those ones who wish to come into your your area, your space, if you will, those problems will be dissipated as the funds are made available where you might make arrangements for their bed and board elsewhere, but nearby.  And yes, you will enlarge this dwelling and there will be more space available and I would suggest that when you do such that you build little kitchens good little facilities whereby these ones not only can function without intruding upon your space but so that they might have their space on a temporary basis. There will be many ones coming and going and if you have filled your space with those who would simply stay you will have no space for those who need to come and go.  So use discretion now and as the plans unfold and as the finances are brought forth to you, you can expand with those plans brought into the overall picture. Do you understand what I am saying? Would you wish I stop a moment? Have you turned off this recorder? Oberle, are you keeping checks on this recorder used by Dharma? 

[other speaker] You may go ahead now. 

Are you tending the recorder used by dharma?  Also, alright. Did I answer your last question sufficiently? 

[other speaker] Yes, you did.  And more than that, quite comfortingly. 
34:35
We would wish to bring you comfort. We see the confusion and we see the frustrations. And our wish is that you would have comfort. There is no way to avoid all of the frustrations during this early learning process. It will occur. Know that it will occur. 

[other speaker]  May we get back to our circle of people? 

Yes, if you wish. 

[other speaker] One named Penny Travis, who is roughly of our age?

Oh yes, the little one of the sea. Yes, go ahead. 

[other speaker] Can you tell her, can you tell us how she might fit in our circle? 
35:37
She is another one who plays here and plays there. She is not ready to settle into one game. She will play with her whales for a while. Her energies are so delightful and she is being opened up to your favorite word, incredible energies. She is experiencing visions that she does not understand. The ancient ones are pulling forth energies that she is beginning to visualize in her meditations who come to her as holographs which would appear to be human or physical.  Physical is a better word. Some of them are, or appear to be human, some of the ancient brothers. She has a great Indian heritage if you will and those energies speak to her and they speak strongly to her and she is teased quite frequently by the one you call, call, sometimes not quite fairly, but it causes her to think within her own mind and go within herself to search. She will be most important to you because she will be substantially such a support and as she grows she will participate more and more. I think probably you were asking about how she fits in with your projects, specifically those ones that would fit into her category of expertise. She cannot separate the story because it must not be separated and it bothers her, troubles her greatly that no one will separate the story and fragmented. This story of Sipapu is not meant to be fragmented. Yes, later tentacles of that story may be taken and enlarged upon.  But that story must be done in its whole. Not lengthily. One must take that story and as you see you can read it within a two hour period of your time. It can be made into a delightful story from which others can be drawn. And when those who try to separate it finally see the whole, it will become quite clear what is necessary to be done. The truth held within the pages is startling to ones who are nearing receptivity of these teachings or who already are aware of these teachings and therefore they see the mammoth picture and they say it cannot be done. It can be done in a beautiful way that can later be magnified in segmented portions which would be easily digested by the masses.  The impact must be such from the first one. A story told that causes those ones viewing to go forth and research. And that is why it is being made available to you, the information, to satisfy your inquiries. The original story must not be fragmented. Is this clear to you or do we need to discuss it further? I feel, I feel questions still. 

[other speaker]  I don't think there are more questions at this time. May you tell us about Marcella? 

Are you speaking of Marcella who comes in the form of a black?

[other speaker]  Yes.
41:21
Marcella builds her little wall and says she does not see it all. Marcella sees it all. Marcella’s Marcella's energy comes from one of the very highest dimensions.  She has come back to this plane and brought with her what she considers to be some of the largest odds against herself so that she might learn how one can grow above these negative, negatively perceived odds.  She is precious, she is filled with wisdom and understanding and compassion.  She also comes from the ancient ones. From the past eons of time she is connected to the most high of the ancient ones.  And I see you mentally refer to the ring which was given to you, cherish it. It was given with such open knowledge that it will be a while yet before you understand the full value of that gift from that one. We look for our manifestations as we perceive them to be. They are rarely as they appear to be.  Does that whet your appetite and curiosity? 

[other speaker] Of course. 

Let it be. Let it suffice to know she is special.

[other speaker] That’s all of the questions on our list. 

My, is the list shorter today? 

[other speaker] Yes, the list is shorter today so that we don't abuse the instrument. 
44:17
The instrument is resting very well. She may not rest so well when she starts to type with her fingers. This has been very suitable. This is the growth. This is the place where we had not hoped to be so soon. Yes it is. You are most welcome. We come in love and joy and we are pleased when you call upon us to join you. Know that there is always an energy there for you. I most enjoy the time spent with you. But I will now take my leaves and return to my duties and allow you to continue with yours. I leave you in love and today, may I say, I take my leave because I'm not having interference from the instrument. She hears and she smiles.  But I do not have to simply take my leave today. I could continue for quite a while.

00:05
This is Hatonn here. We're a bit earlier today, aren't we? That's quite suitable. I heard your request. Would you have questions of me today? 
[other speaker] Yes, we have a question regarding the one known as Gay from Cedar City.  Our sister who has the travel agency and whose son is the one known as Joe, which you have discussed with us before. Can you tell her, can you tell us why she was there and what led her into the tribal agency business, which appears to be something of a dead end at this time, and how you might best instruct her so that she might be able to release the financial problems in your care. Please, we would appreciate a rather in-depth discussion which might also be useful to others.
Yes, I am looking into it.  Just a moment. To the dear little one, Gay, it might very well appear that she's been quite deserted. The one with whom she works has chosen to remove himself from your place as quickly as he can.  He vacillates between staying and going.  This is making it very difficult for the little one to function in her state of what she thinks is her reality. She feels incapable of managing alone should the one known as one in her own mind she feels would desert her.  He is simply choosing his own way. It was not a very what you could call wise decision from the very onset, as through the changing periods of time as you perceive them. That particular type of business will suffer greatly. Gay is a very dedicated, beautiful energy who has in many ways already fulfilled her mission here. But we wish that one to find joy and peace as she is quite troubled within her inner soul. Until such time as she departs your plane, she will struggle and strive, seeking, seeking the light, and always seemingly not quite finding it. What is the obvious, as I have said before, is not always that which is the answer.  And we realize it is very difficult when you sit within a given situation that is bringing great pain and great concern to set aside the outward appearances which do appear obvious and go within and see what is really occurring. It is very tenuous for her at this particular time. But there are many benefits if she opens her eyes and looks around. 
05:57
She is attached to one who seemingly has very little openness, might appear to have very little compassion, but he cares, he cares greatly, and he would wish to protect her from that hurt. This allows the one known as Arthur to grow and make a contribution. It has also allowed the one you call A.C. the brother to participate in a quite unselfish way. This is good for his growth.
As within himself he is completely unselfish, but without himself, he is quite selfish. And he is bearing a heavy, what you would call guilt trip, because he feels he has benefited in the largest way from the properties left by your parent. It is why he has moved most of his operations, business-wise, into the little town. He will outgrow this. Don't concern yourself with that. That was not your question. Gay will be alright.  There is very little that we can do to bring her immediate relief, as she has not really requested it. You have inquired what she might do to release it into her, our hands, so that we might participate. But we will not be allowed to interfere with her own soul wishes. And she has not really decided whether or not she wishes, as in your earth terms, to save that business. She is frightened, she is weary, and we watch her with compassion as she vacillates. The area is an extremely important one. The ones called the Mormons knew of it. And that is why there is a settlement in that given area.
10:01
There are many very high energy places within the state you call Utah. There are other crystals than that one upon which you sit that will eventually need to be linked into this major computer system if you will upon which you reside.  The little one gay has much to contribute to her fellow man. Her mere presence brings joy and peace, even to those in sadness.  She experiences their own sadness, which is not always good for her little vehicle. Sometimes, ones come to earth that are like big sponges and they absorb all the pain, the hurts and the sadness from others. But her rewards will be great. And through these difficulties as they are perceived by you ones, great unity is brought within relationships as one learns to rely upon another who is longing to play that particular role. Now you ask what she might do. She knows what she must do.  But I will outline it for you once again. Leah covered it very well with the dear one, but I see that the dear one would rather hear it again, so that she does not have to think about it. That is fine. That also got her attention. As Leah stated, it is the true request which we are permitted to honor. It doesn't really matter to whom out here in our dimensions those requests are directed. Her guides, which she has, whether or not she knows or recognizes them, are always there, especially in a state of meditation and prayer. But do not think that we must be in between you and the Universal Father, for that is not so.  The one known as God hears every, every prayer. Because He dwells within that place, which is your center. He is you, and you are He. But you must go inside that place, that inner sanctuary to communicate with him. Because the outward consciousness of your vehicle, that which is always uppermost, does not have any idea what it really wants. Even in its casual language, it will curse other ones. The inner soul does not agree with that. It will threaten suicide.  It will threaten murder. It will ask for things that are so absurd that even brought to the attention of the consciousness is laughable. Therefore there is no way that we would respond to a call from your consciousness unless it comes in conjunction with the request of your soul. Am I making myself understandable? 
15:48
[other speaker] Perfectly.  We thank you, please continue.
The most efficient way to come within your inner sanctuary is through methods exactly which Dharma is practicing. Perhaps, perhaps it would be good if the dear one would make a tape or send the tape she is now using to achieve her own meditation to contact us because obviously we hear and we come and with practice the little one gay would open like a blossom and allow us in.  And she will know what's in her heart and what her heart desire truly is, but she must get still.
Because in the confusion and the frustration of the moment, she cannot be still. She cannot hear her soul. That only comes in the stillness. We hear the words and then we check and we see if the words coming out of the mouth of the vehicle match the request coming from the soul the life energy and then those are the facts upon which we take action.  There are affirmations and the funny thing with you people called humans is that you take your affirmations and you do not realize that it is simply the repetitive boringness of the words that finally put the consciousness aside to sleep.  And some of it is accepted within the subconscious, which is your earth functioning mechanism and then some of it if it is suitable to your life plan your journey on this plane it is broadcast out into our dimensions where we can respond.  We hear ones pray over and over and over and over. And then they say, “I will turn it over to you God. I will release it to you God. And you tend it for me God. Please God, just hear me and take it." And God responds, “It is so, so be it.  I receive it, and I release you.”   And twenty minutes later in your time, you are back, oh God take this from me, please take this load from me, show me the way. And then those ones do not remain still long enough to hear, long enough to be shown the understanding. What the conscious mind thinks it wants most often would only bring severe long term damages to even the consciousness. We can look down from here and see the whole. You can only see the tiniest, tiniest portion. We have had trouble with the two of you energies in this room. Wanting, wishing, struggling, trying, trying against your own soul plan. It could be amusing, and sometimes it is, as we see the ones wake up and realize what they have been doing.
21:02
And when things are released into our care, it is very, very carefully chosen how those things are brought forth. And sometimes there is a moment of pain before there is that moment of relief. What the little one must do is truly place it into our care, into the hands of the divine one and let it go. If her soul plan is one which includes the success of her little business, the wherewithal will come forth. The knowledge she is gaining at what she is doing will be invaluable to the network at some point. So if you are asking for my suggestions, and I believe that you are, I would suggest you allow her to have this message and ask the dear one to copy. This tape is quite sufficient.  Send it to the little one, Gay, and urge her to use it a couple of times during her day. Her consciousness will understand what her soul wish is. That is our promise. And once she releases it into our hands, it is done. Would you need more? 
23:35
[other speaker] That would be most helpful at this time and we will take your advice. We thank you. We are most grateful. On a new subject. 
Alright. 
[other speaker] You were here at the gathering at the time of the harmonic convergence and we spoke from time to time as to the status of Mother Earth and the tabulations of the results of the harmonic convergence and what effect that would have on Mother Earth...Have those tabulations have been completed now, and may we know the current status of or the so-called... the balance of negative energy and positive energy that was hoped would be turned over to the negative to the positive by the convergence. The critical mass of concept if you will. 

That would be a question more easily answered from ones of the hierarchy as it is such a spiritually related response that I need to give you. And I too function according to the instructions from those divine ones. But as I look down and I see what has occurred as a whole, I would say that there was, you would take it as to be a little, if you tossed a flammable liquid into a fire you would see it burn brightly, greatly enlarged for a moment, until the substance would be gone. And unfortunately on your planet, this is what happens.  Fortunately on your planet, these little bits of flame ups, flare ups, are happening more frequently. And each time there is a flare up, you have many ones who began to walk into the enlightenment. But most are struggling, playing around at the fringes of knowingness. Opening their hands and raising their faces and waiting for some magnificent manifestation to blow them away. So they can go back to their places and say, man it was out of sight in your terminology. It is not to say that those gatherings are of no value because they are. Anytime that you can unite that many energies toward any goal, it brings great power. And there was great power and great love wrapped around this orb you call Mother.  But her pains remain. And it will be a long time in your period of time before those ones who really have the control can be enlightened to the point of making the required changes. And you little ones who go to these gatherings, walk away, read the paper, throw up your hands, and say, What can I do? And it is your privilege just to be and not to do. And that is usually what occurs. I would have to go to a higher level to find exactly what the tabulation is or what the divine energies might have chosen to do as I have not been fully informed.
But I remain on alert. Evacuation plans remain in effect. And from that we can deduce that things are still extremely tenuous. That is not to discourage you. That is simply to remind you to heed the warnings that we send and be prepared within yourselves because most of your fellow men do not understand even though they espouse the words. Am I reaching you?  If you need more, I could inquire, but I think possibly this is sufficient. I feel the little one here stirring, and I think it is because, once again, her curiosity is remarkable.  Yes, we've come a long way in a few days. Don't be distressed. We are very pleased. Very pleased.  There was an accomplishment in some areas. Much positive energy was put forth. But unfortunately, the ones thinking in secret have proceeded with their testing in many areas about your earth. Things are once again in tremendous upheaval in the area of China and between those energies called Chinese and those energies called Russians you people of terror divide everything up into such ridiculous little portions and then fight each other across the borders of those ridiculous little portions it isn't even that either wants the other, it is simply to do battle and Mother Earth is so weary of the parasites doing battle upon her skin.
32:21
We are still in a state of maintaining the axis balance to some extent. It is shifting gradually. We will not call it a loss. Let us call it a shifting gradually enough that we are able to maintain to the extent of withholding absolutely catastrophic consequences but it is slipping it is slipping. [Phone rings] It is fine. Answer. 

[other speaker] Hello?  You're doing your thing. No. You can do whatever you want to, and it's about as close [unclear]
The energy known as Diane needs to keep in touch. Hers will be a great contribution. Encourage her. Hold her close. As we perceive the instructions under which we are operating and we look down and we see what continues to transpire on your surface we feel no great encouragement all we see these wonderful spots of light, these little flares coming up from here and there and they will sustain you and from those little spots will grow, the words are not proper, but from those little spots will blow the energy, the love energy that will rebuild.  And there will be that rebuilding, but you already know that. That is something else that must come from within the soul, the knowingness. You already know those things. And you, like all others, want a blueprint. You want a roadmap. And we know it is because you wish to look at the road map and where you see the bridges out. You want to make sure you don't go to that bridge and fall off. You prefer to send in the Seabees and have them rebuild the bridge and then you go over it. It will not be that way. And there are no roadmaps.  Would that suffice for now? 
36:27
[other speaker] Yes, that will suffice. Next question. On the eve of August 17th, Rita received a message from Sananda which was given to me indicating a change of direction. And are we, am I meeting my perceived commitments with respect to that direction? 
Do you not feel it, dear one? 
[other speaker] I feel it.
You are doing fine. You have worked long to hide, to cover up, to stuff it down. You will be fine.
37:27
[other speaker]  Now I have some more people that we would like to inquire of as they relate to our circle.  The first is James Morehead. He should be easy to locate.
He is easy to locate.
James comes to your sphere with a little too much knowingness. He enjoys the game almost more than any energy that comes into my immediate attention. He has a path to walk, but he is extremely bored by the inadequacies of his fellow human beings. Hence you see him leave, you see him go, you see him come back, you see him run here and you see him run there, much as the one Michael, only in a very different way. James brought back with him to this sphere on this occasion, much knowledge from his other experiences and he has simply come back to re-experience and to continue the play. He will be a dedicated worker but he has basically come because he knows the answers. He’s comfortable within his inner self and he simply wants to experience once again the challenge, the excitement, the feelings that really are not available anywhere else other than on your sphere or at least in the universe that you would comprehend. He had come in with his slippery little technicality. They all knew you could not find an attorney and get the proper paper spotted in time on New Year's weekend. Had it been that you filed the right paper, I will guarantee you Mr. Horn would have had another technicality. To the extent that he was sure enough that he dared risk bringing that auctioneer. You will call Steve Schaefer. Now he is going to be really aggravated, too. 

Those poor little things in the court clerk's office did all they could. What the judge told you was that you had to file the correct answer, that you did not file before, asking to set aside this judgment of default. I want to tell you right now that Stephen Schaefer would not have done a correct set of documents. It might well be that in talking with Linda Carter, she might have seen through it, but not just coming to court on the last minute today. And you ones cannot believe how bad it is. You have to see it. There is nothing, most ones would not even bother to listen past the first two minutes of a news broadcast. There is nothing like sitting in that courtroom and watching that happen.

Other speaker:… turn from a rotor (other speaker collaborating) let’s say the lifting into a propeller for propelling forward.

01:58
Hatonn: Yes…yes, it can be taken farther than that. And there is a little company trying to do this and I would like Oberli for you to put into your mind how he can get in touch with Larry Doolin. There's no reason, number one, you can't have a factory for that here. I don't want it tangled up with the factory with Northrop. So you can do two things. You can develop them, and you can utilize them. And right now they're trying to get them all hooked up in the military. Let's keep it away from there.

Let's try something for civilians. 

02:42
Other speaker: It's like Gorbachev got that same idea. Sounds like he's cutting back to his military adventures and going to turn that into a luxury, let's say, for his people. Is that true or?

Hatonn: No, there will be every effort made for that in all honesty, and let us just hope we can keep peace that's why we are growing. 

03:18
Other speaker: The same time the Gorbachev is telling us that that's what he cares to do I notice that our military and budget in the new budget that's just being proposed at this point has increased considerably. I thought we were supposed to be the peaceful people, but we were sort of teachers of this.

Hatonn: You've been told a lot of things. And it is still a wonderful country. When I point out the negatives, please don't feel that we are degrading the country. The world is in terrible, terrible pain. You've got the enemies. The darkness is at work. And plenty of fertile soil for it to grow. 

03:47
And that's why a city like this has to be built on the grounds, basically, of just good business. We don't come building communes. It doesn't work.

We have to build and lead. And people will follow. For instance they don’t have to know necessarily, except who is utilizing, let me put it this way. If you have a helicopter, and Eleanor comes to ride with you, Eleanor does not have to know how the plane thing works. Just you. And maybe you don't have to know how it works as long as you know how to fly it. 
So everyone in the world doesn’t have to know how that helicopter works, but somebody does. And if it is good, and if it gives man joy, man will use it. And if it is well built, he will use it again and again and again. That's called capitalism in its purity. Man will come back to buy it because it is good. He may buy it the first time because it is novel. And it is just like those who sold ironing machines. The minute you had permanent, pressed material, you didn't need the ironing machines. We keep them around now so that if you go through a period of tribulation and you're in a war and you're isolated, you can sterilize your bandages by running them through a “mangle”. Your sheets that you might have to tear into strips.
It is the best way to sterilize, is with that intense heat. 

But it sure wiped out the ironing business. People will sit and watch black and white if it's an inch screen or something, unsophisticated. Now they demand color, television. Or if it's black and white, that's fine, they'll put up with it. Doesn't mean they know a thing about television, but you will hardly ever find a family in this world, in this day and age, that can afford it, has seen it, and can get their hands on it, that will not have one. And there is not even, there is less than a tenth of one percent who even understands how a light wave can produce a picture.

Only a tiny fraction of the population will even think about it. We will build. We will pay well. We will not need labor unions. We will be more than fair. 

07:26
We will overpay the worker who keeps your records. She is the one who can also kill you with the IRS, by botching it up.
 A hospital should pay their janitor more than they ever thought of paying their administrator. That's where disease is either stopped or spread. In the cleaning. 
You ones practice bad business?

All you need is to practice good business, good discipline, allow ones to grow in their jobs, you're not going to have trouble. COSTCO markets do not have trouble, they start their cashier at $30,000 a year. Starting salary. They have no employee problems. They monitor themselves. And they have plenty of incentives. You're going to have a different kind of management structure. Everybody's going to be an officer. And that's so you can get “officer loans” instead of taking it in salaries. And then you don't have any income tax to pay. Just borrow and borrow and borrow. Perfectly legal. They all get busy and they'll change the rules. We'll change too. We'll find our next loophole. You'll get just enough to keep them off your back. And that requires some good management in that area. So there will be no limit to the number of ones you will need. Not only will you have a helicopter flying service, but you'll be producing them.

And that brings industry in. Let us just say you're sitting out here on this little island… You're going to need to get back and forth, aren't you? 

Other speaker: Which little island is this, Commander? 

Hatonn: This is called Tehachapi.  

10:25
There will be a day when this is an island like you would perceive Catalina. It's quite a ways out there, but you're going to find something else happening. You think you're old, I laugh at you. You don't know what old is. 
 
Other speaker: I may need a different body in order to be active in some of that activity. 

Hatonn: There's some of you who too are going to do your job and you're going to want to make your transition. You're going to say, well, by golly I did it and I'm tired and I want to go.

Awful lot of you are going to want to stick around and enjoy this period of accomplishment. For the ones of you who don't wish to stick around and enjoy it, that's why the Allens and the Riggs. 

11:19
This is why the little children, this is why the little Eli's and the Jason's and the little Jeremy's and the Ryan's, they will fly those intergalactic ships. Anybody wanna take that a thought further? If you are already building aircraft, guess where we're going to stop? Right where Hatonn is. Right where Germain is. 

12:08
Other speaker: Commander, I read in a tabloid a week or so ago, I meant to bring it along a bit, where an interstellar spacecraft had crashed in Russia and the, as in the wreckage, they claim, was a 700-page maintenance manual for this craft that the Russian scientists say that they have in their possession and that they will build a real interstellar spacecraft shortly. Can you comment on that at all?

Hatonn: Yes, and you ones will, you ones will now get some good, credible confirmation. 
In December, a year ago, we were called upon by the Russians, you were about to have another situation such as Chernobyl. There has been already a second situation at that very place. As they play with their scalar beams, the particle beam system, it fed back along itself at Chernobyl. That is the horror of that kind of experimenting. You have had a second one that has been controlled. You see, you cannot control it on Earth. Once it has begun to build its chain reaction, you have no way to control it. 
Your leaders know us. So in December a year ago, they were trying to play with theirs, and it got out of control and they called on us. And we came, well, a ship in my command came. To get it back under control, to interfere with that energy chain reaction, requires that we get our craft into that energy space and it wreaks havoc with our systems of control. It comes into our energy field. We have to get that close, depending on the severity of the, of the chain reaction.

So we lost a craft. And we lost ten, well actually nine and a half, one will never ever recover... Nine were immediately killed. Three of our crew were saved. They have not only do they have that craft, but they were very, very grateful. And they did everything humanly possible to tend those crewmen. 
And they in conjunction with some of our medical specialists, I guess you could say, worked with those men for several weeks until they were strong enough. And then they were transported back to their home planet. They have the craft. They have a lot of information. The same thing happened a second time. Just before your summit meeting, I believe they called it an explosive. It was a large explosion. I don't remember what the paper said. It was the same thing. They were trying to give you a little bit of a show of power. They were going to do some pretty remarkable beam studies and it would be public, of course.

Other speaker: When you say they, Commander, who do you mean? 

16:18
Hatonn: The Russians. Right now I'm speaking of Russians. Again, we sent a craft. This time the craft was also brought down. It crashed for all practical purposes, but it was more just damaged. We lost no crew members and the crew itself was able to repair that craft and get it back into service. There was also information shared at that time. You can be sure that any information will not be in total. They know it, we know it, and your government knows it. The closest thing that you have had that would be similar where we were deliberately called upon was at Livermore. Once again, your accelerator in Mr. Teller's facilities. And as the capacitors began to blow and the transformers went, they knew they’d had it. They called on us. We did not have to get into the energy field to get that under control, you see we're already standing by along the San Andreas. And I'm talking about acceleration at rates that are beyond anything you can think. But it was instant, the moment we were asked! These are the things that are terrifying to me in the universe.
Out of control, it can destroy your planet. And that gives us a great deal of problem in the universe if we're just going to put it on a practical level. 

18:28
Now for you ones, when I tell you about Pactek and Lato, these are commanders, you're going to find that these ones are a little bit more sophisticated in many of the technologies than are the ones from Reticulum, but they're going to be very, very similar to the Reticulum ones. I tell you about these two energies because they will come into your conscious knowledge. They are small, five feet less around, they are baron headed, they are large-eyed, and they are the ones that work in the quietness, infiltrate if you will, your leadership.

It will usually be under Andromeda Rays guidance. I think you call him Andromeda Rex. This one is usually the one that will interrupt radio signals, for instance at Vandenberg Air Force Base before we stop the missiles. And Andromeda Rex spoke at long length with the ones at the command desk. And those ultimate decisions are made by the communications directors, that always, always, this is for Alan, but always, call in Korton. 

Andromeda Ray will usually be the voice that will be heard. He will be the spokesman and there is no playing around with it. He will tell exactly how it will be. Always you ones have a choice. But when he says it will not go, you better believe it will not go. 

The reason that you're having some relaxation, if you will, is the Russians know. There is power larger, they cannot fight us. The Americans will still flex muscles. The funny thing is, I have sat in their meetings. We know each other. And yet you cannot afford to let your guard down because out of China will come your demise. 

22:00
They're getting desperate now. They're having famines.
They're having changes in leadership. Hungry men, will do anything. 

(Other speakers conversing, inaudible, convesation) In China? Starving? I hadn't heard that. They don't have the food. They're sort of... They've had tremendous drought. They don't have the clothes to ride. They're not aware of that. 

Hatonn: Oh, you precious ones. There's so much of which you're unaware. 

22:48
No matter even what you think your best news sources are, there's no way to get it all to you.

But you see all those years that they were hidden, they were building underground structures, they can house their population. They do more testing than you ones. We are in their skies all the time. We're very, very acceptable. They know we're there. And they dare so push it too far. But you see these missiles that are set up now in Saudi Arabia waiting until your bankers close down their system. They're going to fire those. And they have nuclear warheads.

23:38
 And they came out loudly proclaiming there: no nuclear warheads. Nuclear warheads have been removed. Always that's the clue. 

They are your long-range silkworm missiles that I told you of and I said would come into your attention. I tell you these things will come into your attention because I want you to be aware when they do. You see, it has taken months, months for one little item to come back into Dharma’s consciousness. 

24:15
I told you ones, the reason Star Wars is so unbelievably dangerous is that to thrust those beams that you must have, you must have a homing device aboard a missile in space. You have to build these beam systems close to your nuclear power plants to have enough power for the thrust of the beam, except it has to have a receiving system for the beam to redirect it and then it must have a nuclear device aboard to power the lasers that basically launch your nuclear-powered warheads, the scatter bombs, the scatter lasers. 

And she had to just say this while I talked it. Wally MacPherson was bright enough and scientific enough to say, “but you can't detonate easily an atomic bomb.”
 Oh yes, we can. And so can yours.

25:35
 All you have to do is get the proper frequency and proper sequence and it will detonate every one of those little, what do you call them, safety devices?
But that wasn't what did it. 
Dharma says: I don't know, I never, you know, I can take your word for it. But a nuclear bomb type explosion aboard the missile? Come now, Hatton, you don’t really expect me to say that! 
Yes, I did.
 And now it's going to come right out of your congressional hearing. Because ones in Washington are beginning to open their eyes. The other night she's sitting there watching some channel on power. The power of staff who got you into SDI on the words of two unrelated staff members, and the President of the United States. And the statement came forth and shocked the pants off of your security service, your joint security command I believe, with your officers of your government, these were advisors! And it dumbfounded most of them.

The ones of the scientific community said number one, it could not be done in that period of time. Number two, that requires, get this, a nuclear bomb on board the missile. Now when this comes to the attention of the senator or the congressman that is being complained to, he says, well: “surely you don't mean a bomb. 

27:47
Yes sir, I mean a hydrogen bomb. A bomb? Could we not call it, and quite frankly, it was so trivial that it slipped Hatonn's mind, a dispersing explosion or something, detonation, that wouldn't sound so bad at a congressional hearing and wouldn't shock the populace to know that you are planning to explode hydrogen bombs, quite frankly, out here in outer space. Well, you won't do it.

You will not do it. Not if we catch it. We don't deal with these things much more in this room. We have a city to build. Proposals to write. 
We outgrew that. I will sit and discuss these things and as long as I see the wheels turning in your head, I will continue to discuss it. And we are monitored here. That's why I don't discuss it anymore until I know it's public. Actually, we're getting a lot of help from those young men who monitor this room. There are many, many things now that I want at some point, just as with Star Trek. Somebody is going to punch up on a computer and all of this will be there because you have been under surveillance since the beginning. 

29:42
And out are going to pop diagrams, descriptions, writings, truth. But you see, the monitors want to live. Even the dark brotherhood just wants to wreak havoc. It does not want the destruction of this planet.

And there are energies on your place that would blow you away without batting an eye.

30:25
Beware of the ones of the far east. In the Middle east. Because their religious fanaticism has already trained them it is better to die and make that transition. They never have forgotten the trail of infinite life. So you can’t threaten death with death of the human form. Every human will tremble in the face of death. That's why if you can catch the terrorist, you can terrify him about it. 

31:18
But when he goes out to do his job, he is so psyched-up in your terms, that death means nothing! It’s honor, it’s better! 
It’s only when he gets back into his human consciousness that it looks, it might not look so great. And that is a human trait to wish to hang onto that existence. But that's why terrorism will not be stopped. It's part of the sorting. It will not be stopped. How can you stop it? 
You threaten death, hanging? If that's partial end to what you're trying to achieve for the betterment of your soul… And let me tell you, you're going on the basis of soul change into another dimension of light. The dark brotherhood has as many on this place or more. And they're waiting to get back into that dimension with their brothers on that side. 
You will never fight it and win. You will build better and men will follow. It's your only prayer. 
And you look from one to the other and say: can't be done.
We’re just a few!... well a few will gain a few, and a few more will gain a few more. And then as you are going, maybe it will be money that will draw. But when man sees light, and hope, awe you will be overcome with ones. Man is desperate, man is dying of the need, he is searching, he is looking… You will have help. 

33:54
And yes, throughout the eons of time, at any given point in any civilization, there has always been “one” that can change a civilization. And you don't have to do it with “one”. I’m just telling you it can be done. That’s so you don’t feel so bad when only four of you have to do it. (laughter) No, this is the promise of this particular time. Man, one, does not have to go to the cross alone. And you're not going to the cross, you're going into radiance. 

Other speaker: I'm glad you called my name. 

Hatonn: Thank you.
I'm glad you perceived my statement. Ours is not a trail of death, of either the body or the soul. It's a trail of life. Doesn't mean you're going to just walk out there and they're all going to hand it to you. You can be jolly well assured that life will be interesting. And as long as you accept it as simply interesting and experience, they will never get the better of you. And if nothing else comes from this dwelling, no matter how it ends, everyone who knows of this dwelling knows there was no reason for it to go this far.

It has been a totally absurd set of circumstances that could only be controlled. And not by men. Man blunders, yes. I doubt he blunders 15 times on one document. It's glorious, fun job. You ones think you've reached retirement? You're not ready to die. And that's what retirement is. What retirement should be is finally reaching the point of doing what you love to do the very most. And if it's golf, go golf. You see? 
36:10
If it's reading, go read. But because they cast you out of your job and you're bored to death, because now they tell you you're too old and crippled… And you know why you get old and crippled? Because you believe them. 
There is one thing about it that I do not understand:
Man will cling to the negative at all costs and cast us aside who promise life. That is an interesting phenomenon. 

Other speaker: Is that only true here? 

Hatonn: For the most part, on planets such as yours. Is that your question? 

Other speaker: Yes. 

Hatonn: No. That's another egotistical misbelief. The biggest misbelief is that there could not be other! Second, that you are special in some unique remarkable way. There are not places big enough to hold All of the dark energies! And if God can create you, surely he can pump up a few more.
(laughter)

The facts are, there are as many as God chooses. And when he chooses, he can bring every fragment home. And this is what is often misperceived. And this will be where the stones get cast first. Ah, Shirley MacLaine says, you're God. I'm God, she's God. Well, your Bible tells you you are, and everybody wants to quote that all the time?! Truth in that book, and I'm not making light of it. But there's selective truth. Surely God really didn't mean that. Well, when he says he dwells within and you are the temple of God, what does that mean? Almost any kind of distorted understanding says there is a fragment of God within. And when you hear fragment, that means a portion of the whole, and that means at some point there is only one source. 
And therefore all eventually goes back onto the one source. Therefore you are all one, and you are made up of God, and a hunk of meat and metal and minerals and vitamins. No glory in that is there. The glory is in the essence that is God. The rest is a body to house, to be utilized as a tool, sent in to house that gift. That essence, that gives you life, that makes you You!

And along with it, sometimes I think to play a trick on the man of the universe. You choose free will. Well you see a lot of the other planets do not have the type of free will that you have. They've evolved to the point where they don't behave as you. So you’re studied very closely, other energies…(chatter) go, yes…

Other speaker: is clinging to the negative a third dimensional phenomenon? 

Hatonn: Yes, basically it is. Yes…The others have no need. You see, once you come into knowledge, you have no need to cling to it. And as you reach to the higher dimensions, you come into knowledge. That's all enlightenment is. That is all enlightenment is, is knowledge. 
By shear definition, and the Age of Enlightenment, it is the coming into knowledge. 

41:00
I'm talking about real knowingness. 

Not an atomic age, not a mechanical age, not a Newton age… I'm talking about knowledge. And then you have no need for those other things. You go about your higher dimensional growth in a different way.

But you're going to have a lot of third dimensional, what you're going to perceive as third dimensional, creatures on many hundreds of thousands, millions of the planets. And your scientists know it. 

Other speaker: I notice you frequently refer to humans as creatures. I think that's an interesting... habit or?

Hatonn: Well, I don't mean to be selective. I also consider myself a creature. Any a life form, to me, to us, is a creature. 

Other speaker: Creation.

Hatonn: Thank you. That's a better definition than I would have thought of. All is creation of God thought.
Well have we bored everyone now to the point we can listen to Germaine. Dharma would enjoy it.

Oberli: Yes, and we are, time for a break I think. 

Hatonn: Then let me take my leave.
 I would like her to hear it. 

OBERLI: Ok

Hatonn: It's a little hard to always be on the spouting off edge. And I like to share when there are other ones that can and will. So be it.

Oberli: Thank you

Hatonn: With love and great, great appreciation for your coming and abiding with us a little while. It's not the most fun place to be. It is a place of instruction anymore and we don't get to share the just simple comradery that we did, but all, it is glorious fun, isn't it, to see growth like this, to picture these buildings and their magnificence. It makes me proud as a teacher. 

Other speakers: Salute Hatonn...

Hatonn: Salu. Blessings. Blessings. Father.

43:41 END OF MEETING

MEETING TAPE: G.C.Hatonn

HOW TO COMMAND WHAT YOU WANT

0.00
Oberli: This is Wednesday, January the 25th, 1989. Greetings, Commander.

Hatonn: Good morning. (Participants responding) 
I come in light. 

00:15
I think we should pursue this just a little bit farther. I see several things have happened here. One thing is that John and Julia are extremely busy getting these 14% CDs established. The major Japanese transactions, some Mexican transactions, some interstate, WIC state, as in Virginia, transaction. Extremely busy, working into the night, both of them. And as a matter of fact, when these ones that come in late into the game, began to fall apart, the typical response, once the funds, the…what would we call… the commission amounts, are eaten away from a transaction because of trouble. It is easier for man just to let them go when you're dealing in these magnificent sums.

Let the whole transaction go, go back to bed, start over, and see it through again. When there is shock abroad, there is shock from London all the way to Hong Kong, somebody has called it. Well we botched it up, we did a little mental game. Once again, it would be just one that never quite closed. But there are billions of dollars that, quite frankly, we could be utilizing part of. And it has to stop somewhere, and it has to be gained somewhere. And if you allow the rotten apples to continue to infect the barrel, it's your fault. You deserve what you get out of it, rotten apples. I'm not saying that you're now going to start restructuring and cleaning up the banking business any more than you're going to be able to clean up all the problems of the savings and loans of this house, but you’re going to demonstrate to yourself that you do have power that you do not know you have. And you have a bit of help, that is more important to me that you know than it is what is done over this one transaction. 

03:24
I'm going to tell you the inside workings of this game.

In the first place there was shopping. It is like having a sale and no one comes. It is very traditional. Of course you're going to try to get the best deal. Either side, that's not good business unless you do it. On the other hand once the commitment is made and confirmed. That means that the collateral truly is covered. So that is no business of any of the rest of the players. That is ploy. That is a ploy to buy half a day, or a full day. Because you see what happens, I will find out, I will be right back in touch with you, and got called away from the office. So you buy another day of interest on a billion and a half dollars that is displaced. You use the slowest means of communication into bank… You mistype a digit. You misspell a name. You have some calls coming in from Mr. Johnes and Mr. Yamamoto, and Mr. Kroger. They're all figment, but to cover basis, someone probably representing all names will make a phone call. It's easier to make the phone call and have it documented. But there's no basis for the very ones to be even named within the banking community.

You see, they're not showing up on rosters, on telephone directories. Now, these banks have many, many branches, but there is a central computer that has all employees. Ordinarily, Mr. Lennon could say, “you blew it. This got to be public and now there are a lot of brokers involved”. But you see, all of his information is erroneous. I want to remind you, Oberli, because it is very important that you connect the two now. If you recall from four years ago, almost an identical thing happened. This was when you were working with one Ben Helston, and he wanted to call the bank, just to check on a transaction. This is why you hold a very sacred trust in your hands. 

07:00
This is what you have purchased with your support, of John Jeffers. You are told the major banks involved. This is something highly irregular for anyone to divulge. Because then anyone can pick up that phone and call and inquire. And I'll tell you, John has blown it.

These faxes, in order to satisfy the curiosity of the ones waiting, have picked up the phone and called. Spouted off the number, as if they had some involvement to check on the realism of the transaction. Always look to your own doorstep. You see there are five major players, and each of those major players have ones at the end. So they will share the facts. And maybe the administrative director of somewhere else will say, “well, I'm going to find out if these ones are pulling my leg or not”. Oberli could do the same thing.
“Well, I'm going to check on John Jeffers. I'll just call Mr. Lennon or Mr. whoever. And I'll give them this account number and I'll tell them I'm a broker, checking on a transaction that has gone astray”. 

It will hurt John worse when he has to know that within the organization this is occurring. And he doesn't want to hear that Mr. Kroger's not real. He didn't want to hear that you better push it. And you certainly don't want to hear that your own friends will do you in. 

09:50
This group will never do in, John Jeffers, but there are too many privy to information.

09:58
So you must always hold sacred the trust put within your hands. And yet at the same time, you see, they would be very wise for anyone who has seen even one maximally with an account number on it and a name on it to send all of this information.

The problem is not coming from John or from Kalinowski. But ones have to be reminded. And if one call comes in, it gives them an excuse to exaggerate, you see. But it's time. And you think: “confront the gray men? How dares he confront the gray men?!”. Well you see you’re not really confronting the gray men, you are confronting a transaction. And it’s time to make the government with its rules, act in your behalf. And I’m using you in very general terms, it’s none of your business to do anything. But I have to let John Jeffers know I'm serious. I’m Hatonn. I will not mislead him, and he must know that we have great interest in his success and we will help him. 
And through that strength you see that flows over into ones who really don't care or don't have any interest, just business. A lot of money is going to be changing hands and it has to be straightened out.

Is there anything that anyone would like to question or discuss about this? All right, tell me about Gary Moody. 

Oberli: As of yesterday, he said that his transaction had been solved, but they had located the difficulty and expected to clear it up by yesterday afternoon. And if that did indeed occur, as he expected it would, they would be closing their first transaction today. I have not spoken with John. When I telephoned Gary, he answered my call and said that John was on the other line. And so I called him back, later on he indicated that John was working through his transactions about the same way as Gary was and so felt that they were both about ready to close and have some funds available. He was most enthusiastic about the dome technology, said that he wanted for us to forward a package to him immediately, and that he was interested in the dome technology not only for the studio use, but for other uses as well.

I think that's about the total of the substance of our discussion.

Hatonn: All right. Don't stop sending energy. 

14:38
You ones are learning a great deal. We have a great deal of humor about it up here, a great deal of pride in you ones. Please, just because it is another day, don't forget to remind Germain to get on it, or Michael, or your personal guide. Where you really demand is your own “I am presence”. And you get very brave.

[Oberli reading] You cannot pass your work on to another, for who is another? Who but you? You are but all of them, and they are but you. It is only through the Great Spirit within that you find higher wisdom reflected in your growth and unity as the symbols on the paper become the language of communication. This is why the symbols, so that you can recognize your brother, yourself. Choices are made and ones must choose and decide whether or not to sit forever within the boxes of the physical or fly free within the circles of infinity. That part of man latches on to that which seems real, the things he can only experience in the physical manifestation of thought, things. The soul longs to regain its freedom with its wondrous flight feathers, but the golden feathers weigh him down and keep him binded. Can you not see, Waka Saka, that you are but a feather on the wings of God, you are a part of that which allows the whole to fly again. Only knowledge can allow the proper remembering that we are among those who bring the remembering as it is, without the lies which entrap the soul and have plucked all the feathers from your being and trapped you in the tar pits of physical squares, holding gold in place of spirit and binding you by the sheer weight of it to that which cannot be held except for a brief time of great spirits allowing. The message is simple, the task simple, and the knowing simple, so simple indeed that man cannot remember. Why would I speak to your heart in this language versus another? Because we are of the tribes, gaining insight and knowledge through the experiences of and among the higher constellations, so that we can recognize one another when the sacred stones are laid upon the sacred altar, Awanka Wakan, that holy place of great spirit, universal, infinite. It is only a part of the remembering, and each of you are only allowed to hold a portion so that you can awaken into alertness, and not hide your heads beneath the blankets, and refuse to see and do your work. Your work is only different from that of another, for without the contribution of each, in perfection to his or her best ability, the whole is but a tattered flying machine which cannot soar. A wing without flight feathers is a useless thing, and yet, to build a glider wing, one must know why another's did not work, what you have done to keep it non-functional, and what will allow it to buoy up the whole into flight. If you accept all the responsibility of all the feathers, then you have caused them to be unable to know their own value, so you must not do it for another. The owl woman at the crossing point is only self recognizing that it failed to gain the wisdom suitable to pass on into the mysterious and wondrous places beyond the door. Man will always conjure an owl woman to decide his fate for he desires to bear no responsibility and then he will effort to kill his own creation because it represents that which he failed to attain. What another thinks of you is none of your business, Dharma, anyone, for that is the problem or treasure of the one in the thinking. Man hates truth, for it reflects his soul failures, for he reaches the point that he only hears the negative aspects of reflection and forgets that he is a reflection of the total perfection as well as that of the negative and dark aspect of being. There is no way to judge another, for none have privy to the contracts of the other. So you can only discern direction from the guidelines given forth from Great Spirit and Creation to guide you according to truth unto the lighted places of freedom. Imperfection is that which allows growth, for when perfection is achieved, there needs be no further experience. Honor the imperfections that allow you to experience and grow into wisdom that you might soar again within the light as the light which you are. How do you want this play to end? Dharma, ponder a minute. How do you want this play to conclude? Let us assume you wish it to conclude with oneness again with God. How can you conclude your play in that manner if you know not what is God? So, how do you wish this experience to unfold? Do you wish those underground facilities to be of the brotherhood of light? Do you wish them to be your security when evil comes to confrontation? Then why do you not write that into your play? Why do you ones always allow the evil writers to write your play? This act within the play will unfold exactly as you desire it to unfold, and the players learn their lines and practice their roles. So shall it come to pass that the play will be exactly as you choose it to become and unfold. Do you think God not capable of holding those secure places in the underground for your safety? All needed is to give life unto His creatures manufactured by man in his evil intent and the very tools of his manufacture will be his destruction. When you speak of enemies say from aliens, what meaning? If these aliens be of God, are they your enemies? If the thrust is that they are enemies of your governments and the business community of thieves and war mongers, does that make them your enemy or your salvation? It is up to you. Are they there? Indeed, I personally am as near as your breath, and you would be surprised as where I might be in holographic aspect at this moment of experience. Where would you have me be, scribe? Would you have me within as your heartbeat or dancing on silver wings as thine enemy assaults you? It is wisdom and maturity that knows that for which to ask. God often allows you to have for which you carelessly ask. For the severe lesson gleaned from the having thereof, I suggest, rather, wisdom in all things and most especially when asking God to fulfill a request. It might just happen, and then where would you be? Now as to confronting questions and ones who seek more clarity through the wisdom of higher and farther vision, we must be patient, for where the personal response is concerned, man is given to experience the multitudes of fools games and the wisdom seems fuzzy. So let us look in wisdom at, say, E.Y., who is now again at crossroads of journey. What has changed in this place, what seems to be happening regarding transfer. Pay attention, if you can have the best of both circumstances, hear what God is saying to you in that inner knowingness. Be patient enough to wait upon the Spirit after you have turned your burden over unto its care. Seize the moment and the opportunity if it be reasonable. In this instance, EY can have the positive of both if he uses wisdom. He can continue to work with the ones who need his physical input, and in allowing them their needs, he can require that if he needs time to journey or make presentation for his next experience, so be it. If the move is to be made sooner, the inner knowing will take care of the nudging. You ones have worked hard and it is coming time for the return swing and some of the reaping of the harvest. EY will be most invaluable in presentation of these project proposals to ones who decide that which will be invested and give credence from physical aspect to ones in the position to make selections, be it for growing algae to type of housing. These are things that you ones must continue to foster and service unto more magnificent decisions come to pass for too few will come into the safety awaiting them. They will turn away from calling good, evil. They will turn away calling good, evil. God can fly in all directions and can do so anywhere and anyway he chooses. Ask and you shall receive, if ye ask in wisdom and sincere petition for your relations, and not just to save your own selfish assets. If ye are bound by your assets, then ye shall be left to those assets. Who am I who speaks with such authority and reminds you of your journey, and sometimes utilizes a good swift kick in thine assets?

You have but to recognize friend from enemy and listen as the instructions come back in answer to your petitions for wisdom. For instance, do you actually believe that we would allow tunneling and damage to the magnificent focusing crystal center for communications and navigation from your star to be damaged or controlled? This planet belongs to Creator and ones that take possession and damage this wondrous living mother. Do you actually believe Creator shall tolerate such devastation, even in illusion of perception? You will come into truth in the illusion of manifestation, or you may well wish you had. If you are of God, what possible thing could you have to fear? If you are of God, you will know that you are protected and provided for as the babe in the womb. It is when you pull away and turn from God that you get into mischief and trouble. Hold my hand and I will take you home. Deny me and you shall search longer for your home. Home is much closer than you think, for man is given to think with that which is within the illusion, as he fails to trust that knowingness within his being. You ones want gurus and go-betweens. Why? Because you have been trained to think you are not sufficient unto self. Why would not your desire to have security be as fulfilling as that of your adversary? Moreover, if ye be of God, ye have infinite capabilities, and ye shall breathe the breath of life into that which is needed for your army, and war will not be in the realm of need. War is that which your adversary to life plans this day against the unwitting and innocence of nations. Do some on your planet have worry and trouble with aliens? Oh my indeed yes. We are the enemy of those who have destroyed, enslaved and torn down that which is God's property. Wrathful is this God? No, just, fair, according to whose perspective? But remember something as you read these words. You must discern your own perception. How knowledgeable are you? Do you see this as a fearful revelation or one of wondrous security? You think Dharma somehow has the gift of writing? If you understood not that which she writes, then you might well be as the rock throwers and advise her that she knows not how to write at all and everything is beyond understanding. If you understand that which is the word or compilation of symbols and words, who is the revelator, the writer or the receiver? Communication is simply that which is understood in intent. The point is to bring the communication into focus so that all know explicitly that which we effort to understand. When the focus is clear and all see the same understanding and vision, so then can you manifest that vision into reality. Ones who do not wish to understand and come into vision of reality away from the humanistic experiences of the fleshly senses, will not understand, nor will he come close enough to receive. He will insist upon being left as the ship leaves port. Do you see? You do not know if God will send a life ring, a spacecraft, or a shuttle to take you underground beneath the horrors. Will you know when God comes? Will you be efforting to ascend when your security is to descend? Why must you make such foolish limitations on God and self as to follow a blind leader who teaches the limitations of God as he, she pronounces that they are teaching the unlimited qualities of God? If you are with God, you will automatically ascend or descend as God discerns. You want to cling to an idea of that which was. No, you are stuck with that which is. Will you lose your very life in the need to hold to that which has passed and shall never come again as was? Do you want to experience the crystal of perfection from within as one with it? For always ponder the possibilities according to another's description of how it might be. If you have already decided in the negative of I can't or it isn't possible, you have already decided, for you will not bring it into creation, you will fail, for that was your decision from onset. If you get off your assets and decide it will be accomplished, anything and everything will come to be. If you take my hand, I will show you where we are going, but if you turn from me, you shall not go on this journey with me, for you cannot travel in both directions at the once. I can give you glory, or you may take your chances with the deceivers who haven't told you truth yet and have given you less. They have proved their deceit and yet still you cling to these enemies. There you have it, precious ones, glory and freedom or bondage and struggle. My path is only through effort toward goodness. I shall hold out my hand until you, until I shall hold the lamp aloft, so that you can see in wisdom, but I will snatch you away to nowhere, nor drag you anywhere. If you deny God, God will allow you to do so. And in the ending if you continue until your transition to deny, then be prepared for God to take leave of you until lessons are learned and visions clear. Oh, heck of a lot. Equal opportunity does not mean the same opportunity. You will claim that opportunity offered unto you, for another's is not yours to claim. How many of you will deny the glories and treasures of your heritage to cling to the dregs of an elusive, fragmented, and binding dream experience? It is the time of sorting, and the decisions are made in the confusion of chaos, because it is that state of consciousness when man makes his choices of life journey. It is the epitome of the battle between truth and the lie. I did not say good or bad, I said truth or the lie. Which will it be? Why are you concerned, say, with those space aliens? If you are of God, you know the following. Evil cannot exist in the presence of God. So if they be evil, they shall be smitten down. If they be of God, then you are in clover, right? The only thing I can give unto you as assistance in deciding. It surely seems wise to me to stick with God because He is going to win either way. I force no one to take my portions. I force none to read my presentations. You can argue into infinity over the merits of one book above that of another, but if one book be wrong, then your argument is unworthy. I argue not. I will always effort to give understanding, but I argue not. So if you choose to denounce my gifts, then I bless you and grant unto you your right to choice. It will be in the ending wherein the truth shall be accounted, and we shall see who brought truth and who the lie. Manifested experience is a game of choices, illusions, and experienced actions. Only through those actions can one measure growth and reality of purpose. If your desire is to remain mired in the ignorance of human bindings, I cannot help you, nor would I spoil your journey by my imposition upon your senses.

You see, if you are in the light, you shall have no trouble becoming one with the light and therefore receiving your freedom, your ascension, if you  will. If you limit your training to the physical expression of diversification, separation and opinions of others regarding your status, then you shall remain incapable of a transition within that light source. In your ignorance you will slay the very thing you are struggling to save your physical form. Why? All of you answer this most important question, why? What do you want? You run hither and yon seeking safety? Safety from what? What for? Why do you desire safety? Say from an earthquake or struggle or death. Why do you want to determine that special safe place in Idaho or California, the mountain or the desert? Is it to prolong a bit of flesh in comfort or to serve God's purpose? When you can honestly answer that question, the insight will pour in upon you like the tidal wave you fear. When you desire to survive only to serve your relations, then and only then have you found your place of safety for it matters not, you are simply safe. If yours is only to save thine assets and necks, then you will search until you find the very place where you shall lose it all. I effort to give you ways of making this journey through the physical confusion a bit easier and viable while you make decisions. I give you instructions and the word so that you can come to trust me in that farther vision. I do not come to drag you into anything for I only actually have the word to offer, the word of truth through which you can find your freedom. God is what love, light, truth and the word.
