If you had no notion of gold, that's a good one to play with. And you walked into this room and there was a whole pile of it sitting in the middle of the table. You wouldn't know what it was.

You wouldn't know what to do with it. Would mean nothing to you. First comes the idea. Is gold so confounded valuable? No. It's going to be less valuable, but it is something pretty and shiny and a value has been placed on it by men. By men. And it does become your most intensive teacher. So again you have to go back to the spiritual aspect of your thought and say, well what in the world are we doing here with this pile of gold? What does it mean? It means that you're going to have to decide in your intent, which is your spiritual aspect, what it means to you. Will you try to snatch it for this paltry little remaining portion of your journey, wandering around here on two legs in your blindness. Good grief, I do sound like a preacher. Well, I'm sorry, I don't know how else to sound. We're borderland, see. They're always trying to teach you how to be a human, while they pretend they're going to teach you about God.

The minute they tell you your gold is not worth clinging to, they pass a collection plate. this tent. And you need the things of the world to progress in the human form so that continue and man can reclaim his creative ability. Logic tells you most will not make the New Madrid fault goes. How else do you think there is going to be a sea between the East and the West of North America? Oh well, but that's going to happen out there when I'm not around anymore to be inconvenienced by it. No it's not. It's going to happen while you're around so that you will be inconvenienced by it. And yet I ask you how many in this room would be totally inconvenienced by it if you've done your homework? Zero. They can take it off CNN, with one exception. Some of you will have relatives, friends in those areas.

Iowa, all those places. You never thought Nebraska might be inundated from a tidal wave coming in from the Mississippi, did you? You see, even the ones who give you their prophecies forget details. So am I giving you a prophecy? Heaven forbid. It's going to be exactly as it will be, whatever it takes. Well, did my just bringing this up now make all of you think about it? It's going to be Hapshon's fault. We never thought of that, Tapton, and now you've made us think of it. We're going to focus that energy and we'd better give off that kick or the new Madeline fault is gone.

It is so poverty-stricken that there may be fifteen living in the one room. To the point that the elders move outside. In the eighties and ninety-year-olds, they wait. upon your own place, through which to reach as many as possible. Depending upon your government to bail you out of your troubles is not acting responsibly. Pushing your warped lifestyles in others' faces is not acting responsibly. Promiscuous sex producing unwanted babies is not acting responsibly. And certainly aborting these little ones before they have opportunity for a breath is not acting responsibly. The sad part is that all these things are viewed by your culture and your society as taking responsibility. For example, if you get yourself pregnant, then be responsible and do not bring that unwanted life into the world. Moreover, if you want your sexual freedoms, then go out and start shoving it in others' faces.

And if you want your possessions taken care of, go to the government. Do you not see what is wrong with the picture here? You have simply taken responsibilities that should be your own and passed the buck to someone else. As soon as you turn your responsibilities over to another, then that one has the right to call the shots for you, to tell you what to do. This is what you once have done, and now you are paying the piper. The enemy has you once right where he wants you and is moving in for the final kill. In the meantime, now the farmers are apt to lose all that they have been struggling to save, because they are indebted to the hilt, and that land, even though it be underwater now, will be repossessed.

Many of the farms have been in the family for over 100 years, and within 20 they are bankrupt. The money changers in your world have no ethics other than to claim what they feel is rightfully their own, regardless of what it may do to you ones. If these ones were not mortgaged to the maximum limits when the floodwaters recede, they would, at the very least, have their land upon which to rebuild. As it stands, however, most of these farmers will not even own their land once the waters recede. Where will they go?

How will they survive? How will they rebuild their lives? Many of these people have never done anything except work the family farm and are equipped to do little else. Your president has promised to send in federal troops to assist the National Guard if the governor's asked. Everybody pay attention to that. Just like L.A. Let's get those federal troops in there and what makes him think he can do that? Well, he's already declared emergency state hasn't he? And that allows him legally to bring in martial law and that means that you will be having UN troops in there as well as federal.

Go on please. Your president has promised to send in federal troops to assist the National Guard if the Governor's asked. What does this tell you once? It shouts loudly of martial law. More tent cities and people being driven off their lands by force if need be, just as your government did to those in Florida last year. As Commander Hatsan has reminded you once before, you are moving into the funnel's neck, and it is becoming quite a tight squeeze for many of you. Remember, the funnel gets narrower the farther into it you travel. Now to earthquakes. Yes, there have been yet more in Japan. They have averaged a week with magnitudes ranging from 4.6 to 5.9. The shakers are not isolated to the area so hard hit last week, however, for it is shaking from the northern tip to the southern tip and out into the ocean all around those little islands. You can look for more damaging activity, I fear, in this place. The plate movements are increasing as is evidenced by the additional activity in other areas of the Ring of Fire. There have been several small earthquakes again in the Los Angeles area that are in the 3.3 to 3.4 range. Earthquakes in Costa Rica in the 4.9 to 5.2 range and a 4.8 temblor in Nicaragua, a 5.9 in the Fiji Island region, a 6.1 in northern Chile, a 5.1 in the Aleutian Islands off the coast of Alaska, and the Mammoth Lakes area is shuddering with low level activity as well.

It should be clear to you ones by the list of activity that your Pacific plate is very busy. It should also ring some alarm that the probability of more widespread seismic activity is most imminent at this point in time. Those quakes that occurred in Southern California in the Los Angeles area were on the Whittier Fault. And that should tell you a lot. That's an important trigger fault for the lower San Andreas. You are simply into one more week of the trials, dear ones. But regardless of what comes upon you, remember that which you once are. For without this knowledge, you are set up for failure before you begin. Unless you come into the knowledge and understanding that you are beings of light upon this world to serve in a mission.

Unless you carry that light with you at all times and keep it in the forward places of the mind, you too will soon slip into the darkness. It is very easy to be all caught up in the troubles of the day and playing the four me games, but I tell you now that you came into your present expression for this very purpose. There are lessons available to you, ones, that shall never be learned any other way. And remember also that the more difficult the lessons, the greater the learning curve. So as each day comes upon you, arise to greet the morning sun with the knowledge of who and what you are. You shall never be required to endure more than you are able, for if you were not able and ready, the lessons would not be presented. Let these words be of comfort in the coming days. Let us draw this to a close now. We have been a bit harsh, I realize, yet there are times when a teacher must come down a little hard upon the students in order to bring home an important point. The point I have brought unto you ones this day is indeed important and one that cannot be missed. I hold you ever in the light of Holy God and within the shield. You ones are blessed and are serving in a mighty way, though it may seem so much mud unto you who are on the front lines.

We thank you and we are honored by your service. Tonios de Clear. Salud. Thank you, Ed. Kelly. Kelly has to do her work in the middle of the night, don't mind. I feel like for some of you here, like Martha for instance, we have a lot of fun in here along in our journey. There's no other purpose in this journey. If we just suffer and crawl around on our bellies feeling sorry for ourself or feeling superior whatever might be the fleshly temptations of the ego we wouldn't get anything accomplished and one would want to say well everything you know coming in those spaceships are evil, those are Satan's troops, ask any preacher, you know this sort of a deal.

I have to ask ones to go within their mind to try to figure out who in the world we do not represent the evil aspect. We represent only the God of Light aspect of experience. It is the time of sorting. It is the time of the revelations upon your place. You have evolved typically as a society of thought creation given the right of freedom of choices. Your society has reached the point in technological knowing and learning that you can create great havoc without any capability of controlling it. If it gets out of control, you can produce, you cannot give full energy, that will also kill you, the manufacturers of these beings. Because evil itself, which does exist, let's not talk old devil, evil exists. in the form of a monster, nor can you blame the poor old dragon for being evil, he just is. We're gathered at the meeting room for a meeting with the commander and our friend from Paraguay, Lillian Freeborn. Lillian's commander. Good afternoon. Are we on or off? Can you hear us? We are on now, finally. Let's get God in here, please. Let's just... Everybody take a nice deep breath and bring in your light. You have a very special treat. We work in this......miserable...

miserable atmosphere that has been brought down on your nations and on your world. And I'm not a biblical scholar. I am the word. I don't rely on what man has written for that which I bring because I work from the other side of your veil and I know. God has never broken a promise unto you, his people. Always there are messengers to come and remind you to bring back into the remembering that which was and is. Always there were the world bringers. Many, many self-styled prophets prophets have come and gone, and a few, a very few, were valid enough that the truth lingered long, long after they were gone. One would like to take my words and suggest that everything in the Bible is incorrect. No, no, no, no. It's for you to discern that which has been tampered with, and after you understand that you carry with you the laws of God as to behavior, attitude, journey, purpose and all those things that are now trying to be drummed out of your existence and realization. You will be able immediately what is and is not correct in the boots. If it be of truth it will always be of truth. If it is not it will never be. What man does is put his own definition onto a term and then announce that I am the decider as to whether this term fits or does not fit.

Leland is known as the Parowan prophet. What does that mean? Well, he lives in Paraguay and that's number one. And Leland has had many visits to the other side of the veil, one in which he lay in a coma for a long period of time while he was receiving his instructions. I do not need to tell you all about him. The one thing he needs to refresh your memories, he met with us once before. He is a biblical scholar in the sense that he can quote you a lot of prophecy. So the next question is, well am I going to quarrel with him, not on your ever loving life? He will recite stories around me. We each have a purpose and we are very fortunate that he was coming this way.

He is one of the few. He is not the only one, which I'm sure, praise the Lord, he would say. Unfortunately for you, of this place, the truth is now into the funnel's neck. You're being wedged in there. And your end is nigh. We ask you to be prepared and one's inject and ridiculed and throw stones. Well the last time you said prepare nothing happened. What does it cost you to be prepared? Supposing it does happen, what are you going to do? Well you should have made us listen. I'm not going to make you do anything. And neither is Leland. That is not his mission. His mission is the same as mine. I just happen to be invisible. But I think you can hear me just as well as you're going to be able to hear him. And sometimes you listen better if it comes from the mouth of a mortal man who speaks for himself. Could Dorma speak for herself? Well, she wouldn't be able to tell you very much. You know, she might be able to tell you about the marigolds that she didn't get planted and that sort of thing.

Her job is not to be a prophet. My job, as a matter of fact, although I could be classified as a prophet because I know how it is going to be, is not to be a prophet to you. I am a messenger. I am a reminder. I am in command of the host of God. God would not do lesser for you than send the word to you. That is his promise. And he would promise always to send a messenger to remind you when your time is near. I will take just a moment and ask E.J. to read the writing that I wrote this morning, because when we move into the rest of this little gathering, I'm going to turn it over to Leland, that he might tell you a little bit about himself. I can tell you now that he was in a coma for weeks. And And he spent that time with God. And he is given to know. And he interprets to the best of his ability as he perceives it to be.

And mankind demands a date. I want to know if it's going to be 3.30 or 7.30 on Thursday the 13th, that it all comes crashing down. I told you before, no prophet would give you that. God alone, with the Son, who does not know, knows. And God is subject to change according to the free will of man if you would get your acts together. I'm honored to share. We all work hard. You ones face the executioner every They first try to take out your dwellings, try to take out your town, then the judge you know is going to throw this 62 year old grandmother in prison. Leland's had it no easier. It goes beyond the ego. The ego goes. It does not go beyond the pain of the hurt or the feeling of responsibility that somehow I did not do enough or my fellow man would understand And I spoke about this as we wrote this morning because these are the questions that come up so much.

What do I do? My brother, my mother, my father, my spouse, my child will not listen. So be it. So be it. You have a mission. And to do something for someone is not it, you cannot do it. So E.J., if you would please. It's not as long as usual, so we'll make it through. Well, it's not as bad as the SR-71. right after they hit the, right after they blast you with a beam, make that swing right over Dorma's house, aren't you finding that entertaining?

Well, just hang on because that shield is just holding steady. This writing began at 9.05 a.m. Friday, July 30, 1993. Is it worth it? Is what worth it? Freedom? Truth? Another's life? Another's soul? How about the price of gold? How about your own life?

What has meaning? Cheaters, everything is relative and certainly worthy of note if for no other reason than God gave you thinking capacity. What are the differences in special beliefs? I ask this for all of the many of you who are adrift in what to say when people question. Why? I see so many of you taking on the responsibility of seeing to it that somehow the world and all in it needs your input to save it somehow. It is your responsibility to offer that which you have and believe no more. Others have come to believe that which they believed by prior training or information offered in some manner. No child was born with man concluded doctrines. Each, however, is born with the God within, and if no tampering is done, the laws of God are simply present.

Here now, however, is where you are more gifted and released than are others from the bindings of the doctrines. There is nothing here which says, go forth and cram this down another's his soul. If you are doing that, my friends, your own soul is in a predicament. It will be enough if you live your life in such a way as to example that which you would cause them to be and act. Accept only integrity from ones in your employ, but place no bindings on another's belief and soul, most especially if they be of integrity and basic goodness. Let us speak a moment of a rapture as a for instance. What mean you by rapture? It is not in the Bible from which you seem to get your other material for basing belief. Most people, however, do not think about it at all. It is accepted because some biblical teacher said it is so. Certainly there will be some sort of saving vehicle as offered by God unto his people. The wrong conception is that you can continue in all the worldly ways of misdeeds, immorality, and still expect to get hoisted off in the twinkle of an eye under some nice insecure clouds. But, beautiful Cheelas, be not in judgment of who will make it and who will not. This is a very physical job in physical format. Yours is to do the best you can, to offer material for consideration.

You need not push no further, lest you assume the very role which is left unto God as his own. I come not to debate or argue or save any one's soul except by desire he would hear truth and find his own way. This is why we have no churches or congregations. Yes, you all need more discussion and sharing of spiritual recognition, but that is not for us to thrust upon anyone. If one's wish or ask to come and share their own special truth, we shall most certainly welcome them. If their journey be toward God and not intent of locking into the human physical prison, we are indeed blessed. If theirs is to effort to pull you away into the multitude of approaches to that which is not of God, you must be fortified with with truth and knowing, and you shall have no problem with anyone or anything you meet in confrontation of reason. We have one this day whom we hope will share with us. Is he really what he says to be? He is. Of course, for if a man believes that is what and who prophecies be unto all? No, no more than mine be unto all a conclusion of righteousness.

I can and will tell you this much. God has sent the visions unto this one, and they match those which are flowing to others of God's vision receivers. Pay attention for what have prepared. Nothing. But if these ones speak truth and are accurate, you ones don't have much longer to piddle around. You can see the signs of revelation all around you. How foolish the child who can see the train bearing down upon him and defies his mother, who also sees but cannot help in time, and stands there to be hit and slain. We are messengers. By that definition means that we bring messages, and in this instance from God, according to his instructions, and he who wants not to hear and see is granted his freedom. So be it. By the way, you don't need to giggle and fidget in explaining who a selected journalist, a ghostwriter if you will. If this is easier for you than trying to explain something which will be wrongly received by the other, do not stress yourself.

It is the information which is in point, not the writer. Simply say that you work for, or whatever, a paper and you don't know. If you do know, then I suggest you ask, why do you want to know? Or do you find the information to be an error? Or what? In light of that which we write, another good response is, that is private because the hazards of identification, in in view of the fact that we all have been threatened. If one does not accept this, why bother yourself further? Why introduce controversy? A person is welcome to partake or refuse. It is not your problem. Proof will be forthcoming soon enough, and you will have laid your track record.

God will be recognized, as will his hosts, when the sequence is in order. Until then, let it go. Release it and let us do that which we are able to do and know to do the best of our ability and responsibility. So be it. Gold. I am, as always, getting bashed for not telling you by express mail or something that gold is taking off on the market. No, I have told you once from onset of our program that it would happen. Be prepared. If you are caught short, it is your responsibility, not mine. It may yet fall again, but this time it looks like a substantial growth in the near run with some fluctuation as one stabilizes. I am not your money advisor. I am your spiritual advisor. Remember, if you have assets in anything on the market, beware. The cards are being placed on the table, and it is intended that the citizens of the nations lose.

The program as outlined is still available to you, but we cannot speculate for how long, because gold may well again get hard to acquire for any program, especially for collateral. At present, E.J. has asked the metals people and the banks utilized to please secure some for probable users. You know who you are and now is the time to act, like last week. If others get here in time, then you'll certainly be given full explanation and access for as long as we can manage it. I repeat, we are not your money dealers.

0.00 It is now alright, we're following you. Now you're getting there. Let me give you a little background because you don't really know very much about me other than taking someone's word else reputation wise. I was born in Frizee's maternity home in Bakersfield Elementary School, graduated from Bakersfield High School, went to Bakersfield College, went to Fresno State College, farmed out in Buttonwillow, several thousand acres. They used to grow a couple thousand tons of tomatoes and a couple thousand tons of watermelons and a few thousand tons of cantaloupes and a few thousand tons of cotton and thousands of tons of hay and grain every year. And in 1970 I started a company in Los Angeles and moved down there with my wife and my children.

In three years we built the largest Toyota equipment dealership in the United States. But I missed having the dirt under my fingernails. I got to the point in time where I just had set my time in the office and had three secretaries and a dozen salesmen and about 70, 80 employees and I wanted to get back to the land. So I bought my first farm in Parowan Valley in 1973, Parowan Valley in Utah, which is about 75 miles up from the southern end of the state. In 1975, I bought another farm in another valley about 60 miles to the northwest. And it was called Milford Valley and it was a section of ground which is 640 acres. I put it all under sprinklers and then because it was a 60 mile drive through the mountains to get over to there, I put an air strip on the farm and flew over every day in my own airplane.

In my own airplane, I could fly over in a half an hour and take care of the things that I had to do at that farm and then fly back. On the 25th of October 1975, I took off my airstrip at my Milford farm and was returning to Parowan when I crashed in the mountains between Parowan and Beaver. I had never flown, and I don't know to this day the reason I was where I was, other than that the Lord had a plan for it. Because I never flew that way. Where I crashed, it was somewhere between 17 and 20 minutes flight time from my Milford farm. When I crashed, I was flying a brand new Cessna 172 Skyhawk. I had just bought it a few months before, oh about six months. I had 256.4 hours that were frozen on the Hobbs meter when I hit the ground, the impact, stopped the clock right there.

I just asked E.J. for this piece of paper, trying to think how to explain to you and illustrate what happened to me. This was Leland Fremorne before the plane wreck. You can see my holding this microphone that this hand was injured. It was cut off. They spent three hours putting that back on. But this was Leland Fremorne before the plane wreck. And I was in a coma for three weeks. I stepped through the veil and was taken through the veil, met the people on the other side that lived here upon the earth thousands of years ago and wrote the scriptures that we have, that we commonly refer to and call the Bible, as well as other scriptures, some that are contained in other books that have been revealed here in these last days, one particularly called the Book of Mormon. And I'll explain that as I go on a little bit later on so that you will understand.

But here is Leland Freeborn today. reborn today, I'm still here, just got a lot of wrinkles in me. Maybe I should tear off a few corners because there's a little bit missing, but not very much, most of it's there. Now with that illustration I'll tell you that at the time that I crashed I had seven children and was farming a couple of thousand acres up there in Utah in Parowan Valley and in Milford Valley. At the point in time that I in a very instant that I crashed I didn't see this tunnel of light and all these things that other people talk about in the near death experience. Just that quick I was standing on a drawbridge in front of a huge castle with a door that was about 10 or 12 feet wide and about 14 or 15 or 18 feet tall.

Huge door and everything was misty around me like in a fog. You've seen these television programs where they drop dry ice and water and it makes the fog come up. It was like that. And I was just standing in front of this door looking to see where I was and what had taken place. The door opened and it was about a foot thick and it opened just as light as a feather, just real quick, just like our normal doorways. And there was a being standing there and he was so brilliantly white and light that my eyes hurt to look at him and I put my arm up like this in front of my face and in front of my eyes so that I, brilliance, the light was so great and I looked down I could see down at the ground I could see where his feet were. And he took me by the right hand and he said, and I'll quote the words, he said, ìGood to see you again, brother. It's been a long time.î I didn't know who he was. And he said, ìCome with me.î And I said, ìI can't see.î And he said, ìJust hold on and I'll lead you along.î So I went through the doorway and everything was so bright I could not even see, I could not look around.

But I had my arm up and I was looking down at the ground and we walked about a hundred or a hundred and fifty yards, which I reasoned in my mind now that's about three, four hundred feet, five hundred feet. And by the time we got to a huge auditorium, I could see the path that we were on and the flower beds on the side and the grass and the lawn and things had normal colors. The grass was green, there were flowers, and there were also flowers that gave off light. I can tell you wherever there is color, we don't really know it today, we can't sense it, but wherever there is color, there is also sound. I see a fellow here in front of me that's wearing a very pretty purple shirt. You don't know it, but that purple shirt has music, has sound to it. There's a fellow here with a blue shirt, and that has sound. That's a deeper sound than that is. Wherever in everything around you, we look at flowers and we see them and they are beautiful and we see the color and when we get close enough, somehow one of our senses says they smell and different flowers with different colors have different smells.

I can tell you they also have different sounds, you just can't hear them with our normal senses. But wherever there is color there is sound. It was incredible. We went into this huge auditorium that was about shaped like a V, and I went down at the bottom with this messenger, and we went up onto a stand like where we are today, elevated above the audience. But then the auditorium went out in front of me like it was rising up on a hill and it went probably a quarter of a mile. It was inside one room. The walls were about eight or ten stories high and they were paneled with entire trees. We see paneling on a wall that's four feet wide and eight feet high and we generally panel a room all the same color. These walls were about eight or ten stories high, paneled with entire trees.

When I would look at a panel, I could tell what tree it was because I could smell it. There were apple and cherry and cinnamon and birch and oak and redwood and all different kinds of trees. And whenever my eyes would fix, just like you look at these window panes here, when my eyes would fix on a panel, I could also smell it. And I could tell which kind of tree it was by the smell and just seeing it. No light fixtures, but all was light. There was no microphone, but everyone could hear, even the people, can you imagine this, about a quarter mile away on the back row. This auditorium went out like a Y, so it was probably a quarter mile wide at the back and a quarter mile away, with a roof over it, beautiful gold handrails and chairs, and all the chairs, they didn't recline back as far as we have where a recliner would put your feet up, but they all leaned back a little bit, a foot or so, and so they were really plush comfortable.

There the meeting was going on and a number of men spoke, some of the prophets that wrote the scriptures that we have the Bible. I spent about two hours sitting there listening. I was asked with this person that took me through the gate to sit down, and I sat there for a couple of hours, and then at the close of the meeting we saw the Savior come in. He came in the door on the left side, and everyone stood up and knew who he was, and there is no question about who he was. He did not even speak at that meeting, but he came in. Then we left with him, and I spent three weeks there, went to many other meetings, met thousands of people that lived here upon the earth thousands of years ago. Some of the people that I met I know, and I don't know how you do this, but they evidently were Vikings or seafaring people or people who lived on ships or in the coast.

Because whenever I would shake hands with them, and there were no kids, they were all adults, everybody about thirty, thirty-five years of age, men and women. And whenever I would shake hands with them. When I was shaking hands with other people I wouldn't, but when an individual that had been I guess a Viking or a fisherman or something, when I'd shake hands with them I could smell the ocean. It's incredible what happens. Ultimately after three weeks I was asked to return to the earth and I didn't want to because I had it made. But there were a lot of people there who wanted me to return to the earth to be their father. Now I had seven children at the time I had the plane crash. Like I said I didn't want to return because I had it made, but ultimately I was asked and given a blessing by the Savior, and he told me that he would visit me from time to time here on the earth and that I would not be left alone if I would return and do what no one else was foreordained to do. And in the course of this blessing, when he put his hands on my head, it opened up to my memory or to my mind back eons of time, thousands and tens of thousands, I guess what you would call millions of years, way back into the history of the earth. So I agreed, and I should tell you too, in this blessing the Savior had, before he started the blessing, he asked me, and he had tears in his eyes, and I don't know how else to explain it to you, but the Savior of the world to ask you to do something and have tears in these eyes, you can't say no.

So he gave me a blessing and I leaned over into like a wishing well. It was about ten feet across and about three feet high, just like you see visually that you would throw coins in and make a wish. But it was about ten feet across. I leaned over into a wishing well after I had kissed and hugged and said goodbye to everybody and I fell right into this wishing well and I flew back to the earth. And that's the tunnel of light. Just like that. And I woke up in a hospital in Salt Lake City. They had fixed my right hand and put me in a cast.

My three fingers stuck out the end of the cast and it went to my shoulder like this with my right arm. My left arm was up and they had tubes and needles in my veins and were giving me blood that way. There were tubes in my nose and tubes into my mouth and my throat and they had, what do you call it, catheterized me, I guess urinary with a bag on the side and everything because I'd been laying there for three weeks. They didn't even set my leg, this right thigh. I had compound fractures both legs. When I regained consciousness I could see, looked at my right leg and I could see the marrow in my bone.

My bone was still sticking out through my flesh because they did not want to do the $10,000 worth of orthopedic surgery. The three surgeons that worked on me for eight hours to set my legs, they didn't want to do all that work with a guy that was in a coma and may never regain consciousness. So they left me lay for three weeks just with sterile bandages over me and when I reached in consciousness I could see the marrow in the bone. After they gave me a spinal I watched Dr. Beck who was the Jays orthopedic surgeon. I watched him with a scalpel cut and it chips a bone out of my leg and put him into a little dish to sterile dish that the nurse had there and he would cut for a while, it took a couple of hours, and he would cut and pick these pieces of bone. I said to him, I said, save those pieces of bone. He said, save them?

I said, yeah, they're mine, I want them. And I said, you know, be buried with me in the resurrection. He said, boy, they've been in your body and their flesh and their life, he said, they'll mold and stink. He said, you'll have to have your wife boil them like a chicken bone and then dry them to, you know, keep them from rotting and smelling. And I thought about it, I couldn't say, honey, I'd like you to boil up my leg bones for me. So I said, throw them away. So they just chucked them, I guess. Anyway, I was cast both legs from the waist down for six months, three operations and two years later before I could walk. I sold my Utah farms, sold all my stocks and investments, everything I had. I paid off $850,000 worth of personal debts I owned. I built an 800 square foot shelter 11 feet underground. An 800 square feet is just about, this room here is about 1,200 or maybe 1,300 square feet. So it's just about half, a little smaller than half the size of this room here. And I bought my food supply for many, many years, water tanks to hold 700 gallons of water. You know what a kerosene lamp is and how much oil it takes to put into a kerosene lamp. I have kerosene in 50 gallon drums for my kerosene lamps. I've got wheat for tons of wheat and beans and rice and soy beans and honey in 5 gallon cans and my 700 gallons of water underground.

My food tunnel is ten feet wide and seventy feet long, stacked floor to the ceiling on both sides. You can walk down through it. But it has got enough food for my family, and I have a big family now for years and years because there has never been a one-year famine. That's a crop failure, a food shortage, or some immediate thing. A famine scripturally always lasts seven years, so you need to give up some of the toys you have and some of the recreational vehicles and some of the other things and you need to get a food supply because if you're in the lifeboat and some food and You're in that lifeboat for weeks Boy, you know, you don't need all the toys or the clothes and everything else you want the food You want to eat because that's going to keep you alive So I built the shelter Well, I told you at the time I had the plane crash. I had seven children. The second day I was conscious I told my first wife Nancy I said I've learned honey and I told her a lot of things that I had learned and she said well I believe you but don't tell anybody else they'll think you're crazy because I had a pretty hard bump on the head. And when I told her I had learned how I was going to have 45 children.

Because some of these men and women that I had met on the other side that really wanted me to return to the earth are going to be my children. And there are some particular physical characteristics with some of them that when they are born as babies I will recognize them. Or I think I will as babies. They may have to grow into young men or women, but as they mature I will notice the particular physical characteristics that go with them and then I'll be able to identify and remember who they are. I tell you that because right now today I have twelve children. this boy got his doctorate in naturopathic medicine and he's practicing in Sun Valley, Idaho. I had a son, then I had a daughter, then I had a son, then I had a daughter, then I had a son, then I had a daughter, then I had a son, then I had a daughter, then I had a son, then I had a daughter, then I had a son, then I began to travel the United States and speak on the radio.

I would go into a city where I had never been, go to the phone book or maybe dialing as I was driving into the city I would dial the radio and go back and forth until I heard a talk radio station and I would find out which one it was and when I get into the city I would call that talk radio station, make an appointment with them to get on the radio to talk and tell them my story. I generally spend a half an hour or 45 minutes as I have here now today telling you a little bit of background to give you some evidence of me so people will know who they are talking with. Then we spend another hour or hour and a half talking about nuclear war and the effects of nuclear war and how to prepare for it and the medicines that you can buy at your local drug store and the things you need to do and the signs of the times. The signs are really taking place.

I've just seen another one in the last two or three weeks and I'll tell you about that. I'll show you in a minute. Well not a minute but probably in about forty or fifty minutes. So I began to do this a decade ago. Now most of the time I can stay at home and radio stations call me from all over the United States. I've talked this year already to almost four million people. I spoke a couple of months ago in New York City on ABC for two hours and I got a half a million people at one crack. And that's the biggest station I've ever talked on. Generally a station has 50 or 80 or 100,000 listeners. So I talked to about four million people already this year and I did not know a date and as of right this very minute I don't know the date or the hour but I was given a visitation on the 27th of June, that beginning this winter, and they are not my words, and I put them in the flyers that I sent out, those are the words of the Savior.

I put them in quote marks, and he said, I can't even remember how he said it now, so I can't quote it to you, I'd have to get it out and look at it. But in a nutshell, after the 21st of December, this is going to happen. The great tribulation that has been prophesied for thousands of years is going to begin. I say that it has been prophesied for thousands of years, not only by Ezekiel and Daniel and Jeremiah and Joel, but also in the Dead Sea Scrolls. I don't know if you remember that the Dead Sea Scrolls were found in 1948 on the northwest shore of the Dead Sea in the Quimran Caves. They were found by a Bedouin boy. Those scrolls were written thousands of years ago, and they have not translated all of them, but I have read the ones that they have translated, and those scrolls talk about the great final war between the sons of light and the sons of darkness.

Now that's not referring to skin color, but it's referring to the sons of light being the spiritual people and the sons of darkness being the followers of evil one, the men of darkness. And it talks about the fire coming out of the sky and the people dying as you would throw out, as you would cast out grain. And the seeds, the kernels of grain, when you're sowing, the men would be dead like that and like flies. And the odor and the smell and the stench would cause death, just the smell. And the air itself would cause death and men would have a black face plague. So those scrolls tell about the last great war. They say that the last great war will begin in Mesopotamia. Mesopotamia is between the Tigris and Euphrates River and is what we call Iraq today.

So Operation Desert Storm was just the beginning, a prelude to the great final war that will break out. We're having confrontations and problems with Hussein almost on a daily basis. I heard this morning that I guess they shot a couple of missiles or a couple of planes or something down yesterday. This great final war is going to begin there, and then it will spread out into what is called Lydia. Anciently was Lydia, which is eastern Turkey. It will spread out into Africa and into India and into Europe and into the whole world. Well, the surprise attack on the United States will come from what was formerly the Soviet Union. Communism is not dead. They just changed their names to nice socialist democrats. But it's the same people running the system, the same people that have the power to push the buttons and launch the missiles. Now everyone is quick to point out when I talk in radio programs that in the last days there will be many false prophets, because it tells you in the 24th chapter of Matthew that there will be many false prophets. I would love to be one of those false prophets. It would be absolutely fantastic. Let me tell you that I lost my sixth son, number six. He drowned, it's been five and a half years ago now. Drowned in a swimming pool down here in California. My wife and the kids had come down to visit some friends here in Bakersfield.

I saw his drowning twelve years before it happened, seven years before he was even born. I would not have lost my own little boy because he was four years, five months, and eleven days old when it happened. The afternoon that he drowned here in Kern County, I was home in Parowan, Utah. Nobody else around. That afternoon I saw what was taking place. I saw who came to get him and all the events about his drowning while it was happening here in Kern County. We flew his body home to Parowan in a private plane, had a funeral at our home and buried him in the Parowan Cemetery. The only comfort that we do have, and it is a comfort to us, we miss Jordy terribly, but it is a comfort to us to know that the Lord had revealed to me twelve years before it happened and I had told my wife, I called her at 3 o'clock in the morning because I was 250 miles away the morning that I had the vision. I called her at 3 o'clock in the morning and told her about the little boy falling into the water and drowning. I did not know it was my sixth son because he wasn't even born. I thought it was my third son.

So we watched him and eventually he grew up and started kindergarten and we quit worrying about him. Then I had a daughter, then I had another son, and I worried about him until he started school. Then I had a daughter, then I had another son, and then we worried about him until he started school. And finally my sixth son, it happened. So I would love to be a false prophet and not have these things happen. I talked last night in Las Vegas and one of the fellows said there, well can't we modify this, can't we avoid this? And I said there's no way we're ever going to convert the United States and get people to believe sufficient enough to cause them to repent and be like Nineveh. You remember that Jonah, the Lord called him to go to Nineveh and he didn't want to go, so he bugged out the other way. The storm came up and the sailors threw him overboard over the ship's edge into the sea and the whale swallowed him and belched him up on the beach three days later.

He had to walk 500 miles. A lot of you don't realize what a 500-mile walk is. Would you like to leave here right now today with what you can carry and know that you were going to have to walk back to Parowan Valley where I live? That's a long, tough walk. Likewise, it sure was across part of the land of Palestine and part of the land of Syria and up into northern Iraq, what we would call Iraq today, to the city of Nineveh. Jonah preached to those people and the city did repent and they were not destroyed at the time that Jonah said they would be. The United States is not going to repent in the next five or five and a half months that we have left.

There is no way. So as I told this fellow last night in Las Vegas, it is going to happen. The best I can tell you is you better get prepared. The Lord says in the scriptures, if you are prepared you shall not fear. He said to me, well what if you are away from home some place when this happens? I said, so what? It doesn't matter. I know what to do. I've got my Geiger counter, my radiation meter, my medicine, everything in my van. When I'm traveling in five or ten minutes I can be sheltered. I know what to do and I know the signs right up to the last few minutes before the surprise attack comes. The Lord has a responsibility to take care of me because He knows I'm doing what I'm told to do. So He'll take care of me even if I have to stand in the midst of a fireball like Chad, Rack, Meshack and Abendigo stood in the fiery furnace. I'll stand there in the midst of the fire, everything else will brown me crisp, but I'll make it because the Lord has given me the promise of what I have to do.

So I've talked on the radio, some television shows, trying to get people, make them aware of what's going to take place. Like I say, everybody knows there are going to be a lot of false prophets, but do you know what it says in the second chapter of Acts? Most of you probably don't. I'll try to turn to it here and hold it up so that we can read it and so that you can see. see in the second chapter of Acts, and it says, And it shall come to pass in the last day, saith God, I will pour out of my Spirit upon all flesh, and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, and your young men shall see visions, and your old men shall dream dreams.

Now I don't know if I'm a young man or an old man, because I have visions in broad daylight just like we are right now, conscious, wide awake, and I also have a lot of dreams at night. And he says, And on my servants and on my handmaidens, so not just men, it's women too, on my handmaidens I will pour out in those days of my spirit, and they shall prophesy, and I will show wonders in heaven above and signs in the earth beneath, blood and fire and vapor I guess I didn't get it in there, I'll have to go out to the... Where is it? There it is. Here's your blood and fire and vapor of smoke, mushroom clouds and the instant of detonation is fifty two million degrees. The fireball one million to the second after it detonates is three hundred feet across. 1,001, 1,002, 1,003, 1,004, 1,005, 1,006, 1,007, 1,008, 1,009, 1,010. You know how big the fireball is in 10 seconds?

It's one mile across and 11 million degrees. That's hot. And everything for the first five miles is gone. So the second chapter of Acts says that my servants, my sons and my daughters, men and women, they will prophesy, and that's what I'm doing. Joel, in the second chapter of Joel, it says, I will show wonders in the heavens and in the earth, blood and fire and pillars of smoke. Matthew 24, 21 and 22 says, For then shall be great tribulation, such as was not since the beginning of the world to this time, nor ever shall be, and except those days should be shortened, there shall be no flesh saved. But for the elect's sake those days shall be shortened. Now, are you one of the elect? Do you know? Do you know really who you are? Do any of you know right here and believe that you are the blood of Israel? Everybody talks and knows the common thing that the press says, that the Jews are the chosen people. It's interesting that you can say the Jews are the chosen people, you can say that you shouldn't persecute the blacks, that you shouldn't persecute any of the Orioles, but if you say, I'm a white man, I'm part of the chosen race, suddenly you're a bigot and they come down hard on you. Well, everyone here, when you go to fill out a job application, what do you put down?

They put race. You put down Caucasian, don't you? Well, the ten tribes, let me go back to the beginning. The first eleven chapters of Genesis covers from the creation of this earth when the Lord brought forth the light and the seas and the animals and the fishes and everything else, the first eleven chapters of Genesis covers from the creation down to the time of Abraham. That's in eleven chapters. That was millions and millions of years. And then from the time the 28 chapters to tell you about Abraham, Isaac and Jacob and his posterity. He was a very important man. And he said, Give me a blessing. And finally the angel said, Okay, I'll give you a blessing. He said, Thy name shall be no more called Jacob, but Israel shall thy name be. And so Jacob was named Israel. Then we go to the 35th chapter of Jacob, and he had a number of wives, because he was a polygamist, as were and as are the men of God who really represent what our Heavenly Father has to say here upon the earth. Because everyone here prays to their Father in Heaven. Our Father in Heaven is a plague. He has a lot of wives. We have a lot of mothers. Jesus said, in my Father's house are many mansions.

We weren't all born in the same home, but we do have our Father in Heaven. and he had 12 sons, Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Isaac, Zebulun, Joseph, Benjamin, Dan, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher. The Jews are the descendants of only one son, Judah. And they nicknamed them and called them Jews after Judah. You have the illustration, you remember that that Moses Well, let me go back so Jacob had 12 sons the 12 sons Went into Egypt remember Joseph one of the sons were sold as a young boy He was taken out of the pit and sold to the the people in the caravan. He was taken to Egypt He grew up in favor's court. He got to be a ruler in Egypt, and he told them he had visions and dreams and he was a man of God because he was of the tribe, he was Joseph, one of the sons of Israel. And he had Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, Jacob's name is changed to Israel.

So the other eleven sons, they come to Egypt, and they stayed there for centuries. And Moses, in the year 1490 B.C., before Christ, Moses let the children of Israel, the twelve tribes of Israel, out of Egypt. And that multitude was a couple of million people. They had 600,000 men in their army when they left Egypt. You must have the responsibility enough to attend cell. It is like your preparations. Why would you expect your neighbor to do it for you? Well, you will say, I really don't because I really don't know how I feel about this and I don't even know how I feel about God and I certainly don't know how I feel about Lela and Freeport and I don't want a nuclear war therefore it's off.

I won't prepare it, it won't happen. B.S. it won't. It'll happen. Because the minute you say that it won't happen and I'm not going to do anything to give it energy, it's got it. He's got to work out with God what makes you bitter. All we can do is try to bring truth to as many people as will hear. it. You can choke that horse too. And as you do so, the frequency of the body itself is so that at point of necessity or desirability, the frequency of the human physical can be refined enough that literally it can disperse into a light beam if necessary.

In the meanwhile, as the body is perfecting itself, these little deambriana particles feed off of mutant cells and viruses and other invaders into the body. Any creator as orderly as the one that created you will give you instructions and the ability to recreate yourself, to make it through this. How many will make it? Cordovans doesn't make. They're going to learn their lessons before they ever get back home to the oneness. And you wouldn't give up this opportunity for anything on this earth. You are among the elect just to be experiencing this at this time on this earth. God sends his messengers, he sends his prophets so that you know. It is not their problem to discern for you.

There is safety in God. Hold on to him. You don't need to worry about Leland, Hatton, Dharma, EJ. You don't even have to worry about Father Cleary. Just make it happen with God and you don't have to worry that atomic bomb either. But before you stop worrying about it, you get a hold. Because when it all comes down, this place here is going to be an island. And you're going to have to be self-sufficient. And how well you do is how much time you have. Now I'm going to throw, Leland, what would you like to add? You got 15 seconds? That's about it. I was muddled when I couldn't remember about Gideon, where it was.

It's Gideon, 8th chapter, 30th verse. The Gideon Bible you've seen in motel rooms and stuff and Gideon had three score and ten sons that was body begun before he had many lives. The other thing I would like everyone to have a couple of these flyers, one that you can keep and one that God bless you to give some to somebody else because they'll thank you. If you get anything and you just retain it yourself, you're not going to make it. You've got to give forth and share your knowledge and try to be a blessing in others lives or you're going to get cut off. So I'm going to give you two of them so that you can pass one on to somebody else. If you've got things where you can Xerox it and nothing, nothing I've got here is copyright.
