You once create these self-perpetuating hells and pass them from generation to generation. When do they stop? The image makers, the advertisers, have kept your heads full of images that will ensure that you will know and pursue what will make you cool. Rather, it is more like cold and heartless. You once need to begin to realize that you are responsible for your emotions.

Just because you had a less than ideal childhood does not mean that you cannot overcome the programming and be more balanced. It is okay for a man to hug another man. It is okay for anyone to cry when they are sad. It is quite okay for ones to give heartfelt praise to another and say that they are proud of them. Most often, especially in children, but in adults also, ones simply need the acknowledgement to let them know that somebody cares enough to even notice them. Else ones will go around creating a way of making people notice them. This is the reason you ones have the problems with the street gangs. These are usually children who find the attention that they are starved for by going out and shooting someone or robbing someone. The parents don't know why their children do these things. The parents do not realize that the children...

This is tape number two on the 4th of August, 1996. Thank you, Ed, for the applause. The parents don't know why their children do these things. The parents do not realize that the children need nourishing love and acknowledgement. Most of these parents are wounded children themselves and cannot rise above their own deep-seated problems to break the vicious cycle that creates this internal emotional unbalance. Ones who come from a more balanced halfway normal family most often do not realize that they have it so good. These ones have a hard time understanding why or how children can go out and shoot someone and not even care who they hurt. These who can go out and murder are the walking dead. They are so shut down that they are nearly incapable of understanding why it might be wrong to do some of the things they do. The only joy they know is the praise they receive from the like-minded, also mindless ones to which they gravitate. Being a parent is such a great responsibility that few ever truly realize the actual magnitude of the responsibility.

In the higher evolved societies, only the more balanced ones take on this responsibility. Thus you have an upward spiraling culture of a more and more balanced nature, devoid of life. You ones must be able to understand why and how it is that your society has come to the point at which you now find yourselves. When you interact with another, please realize that you are, if the person is at all alive, that is, has a soul, with an emotional being who has needs and problems and is seeking to find purpose and meaning in their interactions. They may not always be easy to get along with, but if you can show them a nurturing acknowledgement of their being, then you very well may be surprised at that which comes back to you in return. The natural giving of Creator is that of a nurturing, mother-like nature. You will do wonders for your fellow man if you can learn to reflect this nurturing aspect of creators giving. I come now to impart this message to you who will listen and understand so that we might begin to change the erroneous thinking and mental programs. May you feel and understand the message given here. I am Lady Nada, present in the radiance of the one light. May God bless the children who come during these times, for their challenges are great. And may God bless you ones who care deeply and try your best to give of much-needed emotional nourishment in these most starving times. For while the demands can be sometimes overwhelming, the rewards are indeed great. Salute.

And now, hot off the press from August 3rd, from Saturday, is a message from Lanto, and I will again read the introduction. The following writing is by the Ascended Master known as Lanto the Sage, of the second ray or aspect of Creator spectrum. This is among the seven great Rainbow Masters communicating at this time to help us get through Earthshan's planetary transition and rebalancing. In Journal No. 7 called the Rainbow Masters, Lanto says, quote, I have chosen the softness of the yellow refraction as my most comfortable vibration, and am most easily identified from my past, as you perceive it to be, experiences. My existence in mortal form brought me to your places that you now geographically identify as the Orient.

I was given the great gifts of insight and wisdom from our Creator Source to experience upon this planet in the form of many most humble wise ones. My most revered service was to the one who came first as the Christos, the Buddha, who is brother and one with the Master Jesus. And with that introduction, now the writing by Lanto the sage. I come in the light of the one light. I represent the second ray or aspect of creator spectrum. The visible spectrum of light only represents a harmonic of the frequencies that make up all of creation. In the third dimensional compression, you ones are often limited in your perceptions. Not only are there non-visible third-dimensional aspects of Creator's light, there are also higher dimensional shifts associated with Creator's energy expressions. Do not get hung up on colors associated with a representative of an aspect of Creator. We all, you ones included, express on all frequencies or wavelengths.

Ones are usually drawn to a certain aspect of Creator, thus there is more affinity associated with one area over another. This is because we are all created with a purpose in mind, and that purpose can be most easily filled through certain aspects of Creator. Note please that balance is of utmost importance for proper growth. All ones will gravitate towards Sananda's Christ energy. Many will gravitate towards Hilarion's heart energy or Germain's transmuting energy. This is mostly due to the level of the expressing individuals. You ones are restless and need change.

Thus Germain will appeal to you for he is master of that aspect of creator's expression. You ask, where do you, Lantho, fit into this picture? I am guide and teacher. I am the gut feeling you once get. The physical color associated with my energy is the golden yellow color, though the etheric color would be perceived differently. Ones who can see the colors of the auric field will most often perceive my energy as a blending of colors. I am a teacher. I have learned my lessons well and have earned my position among the other masters. We all have overlapping aspects and can express on any of the frequencies, though there is need to have specialists to answer the specific and directed needs of the ever-progressing souls.

I have come now at this time of change so that you ones might receive balanced instructions and learn to follow your gut knowingness about what it is that you need to be doing. My scribe recognizes me as a communicator. Yes, indeed, I am probably the most heard, but least recognized of the masters. For I will speak to ones at a level that bypasses the analytical mind and resonates within the emotional energy field of the being. This manifests as intuition, or as the, quote, I don't know why, but I don't feel right about this situation, reaction. Even the most shut down emotionally person will, if he has a soul, feel my nudges. You ones must be open to the nudges.

This is most often your guides working with you to help you to find the right path so that you are prepared for and ready to accept your purpose. This does not mean you have to go anywhere. This is to say that your life experiences are being guided for your highest good. The more open you are toward the following of these internal messages, the easier it will be for you ones to get the proper insights and lessons necessary for your upcoming roles. Sometimes these lessons are harsh and seemingly abrupt. For example, ones are losing their jobs all over the country. Be careful in your thinking, for such luck is most likely for good reason. You may be needed elsewhere, and this may be the only way to get you to look within and draw upon the creative energy that will guide you to a more productive experience.

As some ones are lost, others are called to serve. So if your life seems to be turning upside down, please take a moment and call in the light and get still. Notice the gut level sensations. They can be translated into written or verbal communication with practice. This will be as if you have thought of the message yourself. You will most likely only hear your own inner voice. Listen to the message. Write it down or speak it into a recording device. Write or speak what comes, then discern the message.

Remember to always call in the light before, during, and after this exercise. Otherwise, the dark side shall almost surely come to influence and trick you. We are fast approaching a time when you once shall all be consciously receiving. The mere fact that you are drawn to this information source, contact, and are reading this message implies that you are and have been receiving at least at the gut level. Well, imagine that. It is not everyone's task to write public messages for the masses. It is, however, your God-given right to connect up to higher source and receive your own personal instructions.

Your guides are there for you at this time to help coordinate your training and life experiences. Be patient with those around you. If they do not share your beliefs, do not condemn them. For each is responsible for their own self. You do not know the contract of another, so when one experiences as, let's say, a lawyer, that one just may be necessary to help you at a later date. Ones may deny their spiritual side, yet they may be the inventor or scientist who brings new technology to your world.

Ones are allowed to ignore their spiritual side if they so choose. There is no force from we of the Light of Brotherhood. If you come across others who don't seem to hear or want to listen to spiritual truth, do not condemn them. Look to their actions. Most often these ones are the more advanced ones who recognize that religions are very confusing and thus choose to avoid any spiritual discussion whatsoever. Their actions will hold clues to their being. Are they generally kind and caring? Do they know innately what is right and what is wrong? Despite the robotic overpopulation of your planet, it is still full of godly people who only want to do what is right. These ones know right from wrong because they innately feel the difference. This is because they are connected to the God source, even if they do not acknowledge the connection. This message is coming now so that you ones begin to realize that you are receiving guidance.

Moreover, note well that there is fast approaching a time when, due to external physical events, the means for getting the contact newspaper delivered will be nearly impossible. This probable scenario shall serve as a wake-up call to you ones who are still trying to figure out if you really believe these messages of lighted truth. Doubt is one of the most effective tools utilized by the dark side. If they can't dissuade you completely, they will try to cast doubt. Thus the inaction due to procrastination will set you back or cause you to miss opportunities set up for your growth. When you find yourself doubting things such as personal worth or personal beliefs, I would suggest that the doubt is most often adversarially induced. Ones do not like being treated as an outcast or as the one who goes against their parents' fundamental teachings.

When you doubt spiritual matters, realize, please, that there is a real battle going on within. This battle is for the control of your soul, or at least for the influence over your soul. Go within and call upon Creator God, the one who created you. Get quiet and search your heart to find that which you know to be true. Ask any question heart such as, how can I know what is real or true? With such a question asked with heartfelt curiosity, the answers must come. Next you must monitor your thoughts closely as your mind will be caused to give you the answer. Clues and experiences that hold the answer will be caused to be remembered so that you can realize what is true and what does have verification and validity. Rarely will you hear a voice of another, not at first anyway, though it is possible. And remember to always call in the light for protection first. Be honest with yourself and you shall know what is true and what is half truth or lie. I am Lanto the Sage, the Elder, Keeper of the Second Aspect of Creator Spectrum.

May your journey in light be a reflection of the inner God Force who created you and is you. Thank you and blessings to all who read this message. Salute. Thank you so much. These are the bits of fuel for my own soul. So I thank all of you for abiding with us long enough for us to get a little bit of connection. Always there seems to be trivia that hits us because everything except our journey within God is trivia. It's a play.

It's an ongoing scenario in which after a while you can't tell the dream from the vision, from the reality, from the hoax. And all along the way, if you be still and listen from time to time. Those warm moments of contact. Nobody, you see, on this side, who really wants to control your spiritual growth, want to acknowledge those wee small voices, those warm... Only this energy could have had that effect on you. You come to know the energy.

On the 30th, for instance, it was rather an incredible morning. Many things happened. Some joyous, some down. Suddenly, out of the push and the shove of rushing from this thing to rush to this one, there is a little song in the heart that's going on that somehow things are working the way they're supposed to. And very gently to Dorma came her son. from my side, who just softly kisses the cheek, lights a little burst of light, and says, It's okay, Mom. Don't forget. Today's my birthday.

Out of absolutely the blue, and I can get sensitive about it also, because the attachments are made, the connections that never go, never go. These are the life silver cords that make us one. long ago in your experience will someone have departed? Sometimes those memories are not pleasant, but always the love will remain. It will be the love that will reach out across the generations of time. And then there aren't any birthdays anymore. There aren't any goodbyes anymore. And in Jonathan Livingston Segal, were some good messages, fly across forever and we'll meet now and then. Because everyone who is friend will meet from time to time in those spaces in between. It's as sure, it is as sure as your soul. And you will find by the time you come into that recognition, everything's all right. All the forgiveness, all of the things, all that you think you could not forgive, it's all right. Because Because by the time you can make these connections, you have grown, and those other spirit friends have grown.

And it is as if there were no birthdays, no goodbyes. After all, you have to say so long or goodbye, or you won't be able to meet again after those generations. Meetings are sweet and joyous and renewed after these periods of time, after there's been a necessity for a farewell. So let us hold to these thoughts. These are the things that keep us headed in the right direction, so that we can live in the joy of the realization that it's going to be fine if we don't lose our way. Many will lose their way.

And that's not your problem. centered, balanced and focused. And all of the distractions will try to pull it away from you. And I think I would like to leave before the break without reading more so that I can enjoy a little bit the spiritual aspect of our friends. They're our brethren. They are our connections. And they are as real as any of you sitting in the room. I see Mr. Dixon outside. Well, do you think he would want to say something?

I know that there's one other thing I want to go on the record here. With that red car sitting out there. I don't want to hear it back from our friends like we have. Oh, the Eckers have all these cars and all these toys and a couple of airplanes and all these RVs and things. There's a red car sitting out there that in no way belonged to the Eckers. On the other hand, they had a choice of walking in six days or walking in six months. And they chose to wait six months. You cannot buy a used car, you cannot get anything of value on a car unless you trade it in. And they might thank me, I did not belong to them then, but it was purchased through their neighbor, Centoni, over in Mojave. Now remember when the Eckers' home was broken into and the young man went over then and stole a car from Keefe Brothers Rental and came down Eckers Street and Gene, by now, had jumped into the back seat and Melvin ran it right off into the wash and took off, and most of you will remember that.

Well, Ecker is the one who saved that vehicle. So they were pretty nice about working a deal because the transmission went in the other one to the tune of $8,000 to $10,000 cash. And Ecker said, well, I guess we're going to walk. There is not cash to be had for that. And Mr. Keefe said, they would take the old one. You drive the car for six months free. Now, I think that's a good deal. So when this gets spread around, I hope that all of you will remember it's that way.

And not the Eckers went out and bought another wonderful new car. And so where are we E.J.? Do we have cake, pie, announcements? Commander? Yes. I'd like to ask, could you name the color and the name of the Siren Rainbow Masters? Get the book. It sounds like the commander just stole another book. Yes, I do have a quick announcement. spoke with Gene and he tells me that the likelihood of something interesting happening tomorrow is somewhere between slim and none. Those people who have active subpoenas, however, should go on schedule so that they're not held in contempt of court. And I believe the newspaper person probably needs to be there also just to record what happened.

Why don't we take a break and then we'll look at a cop apocalypse of bugs and that always is better on pie. Thank you. An apocalypse bug? Hello, I'm Judy Woodruff and welcome to CNN Presents. No unstoppable microbe has threatened the entire human race so far, but it could happen. In 1918, a mutant airborne flu virus broke out in a military training camp in Kansas and swept across the globe. In 16 months, it killed more than 20 million people, nearly 1% of the world's population. Today, scientists are not only concerned about new diseases, they're also alarmed about old enemies, common infections like strep and staph that are resisting antibiotics that have kept them in check for decades.

Here is senior correspondent Larry Lamont. Would you tie me into that, please? Celeste Taylor isn't sick. Let's go. But she's carrying a deadly bacteria that could sweep through Tampa General Hospital, even kill her twin girls. Miss Mommy, I need this big mask. Hopefully soon I can be able to touch you without these gloves on. It was worse right after the twins were born.

For several days, Celeste wasn't even allowed to see them. Hey, sweetheart. It was hard. I was very upset. I cried for days. And they brought me pictures in, so I would be able to see the babies' pictures. I'm asleep. Two weeks after the birth, doctors still won't permit skin-to-skin contact. Her babies have yet to see their mother's face. Everybody looks at you fine, you feel like you have a disease. I'm just going to do a little culture.

Back of your nose, tell me if I hurt. What Celeste has is one of the most feared bacteria found in hospitals, Staphylococcus aureus. It preys on the sick and vulnerable, causing deadly blood infections, pneumonia, toxic shock. Fortunately, Celeste doesn't have the bacteria in her bloodstream. She's only a carrier. But Staph kills an estimated 60,000 Americans each year, more than die in car accidents. And killing the bacteria has become almost impossible. Staph has evolved, mutated, and become immune to antibiotics.

Today, only one antibiotic is effective against the kind of staph Celeste has, vancomycin. But how long will it hold up? Many scientists are convinced there will soon be a medical disaster. Tens of thousands of additional deaths from a super-staph, an apocalypse bug no drug can defeat. The question now, more asked is, why haven't we seen it yet? It's not will we see it. So we're just very, very close to a situation where antibiotics are becoming obsolete. It's still shocking to think that there are bacteria out there that we cannot treat. That's not the way it was supposed to Why is this happening? In simple terms, misuse of antibiotics. One example, patients who don't finish an antibiotic prescription kill off the weakest bacteria, allowing the strongest to survive. If the bacteria is not killed and it becomes resistant, it can leave the individual and go to somebody else.

I think we see bacteria that are literally laughing at all the antibiotics. They are not being touched by them. In this rural setting outside of Pottstown, Pennsylvania, a woman has made medical history. Her case proves how resourceful bacteria have become. So I figured, operate Friday, she'll be out of here Monday or Tuesday. Carol Rothermaw, a nurse, thought the operation on her sister Joan Ray would be routine. July 9th, you were admitted with pancreatitis. But Joan ended up in the hospital 322 days, primarily because of infections she developed after surgery. I had so many tubes in me, I wonder what's taking care of what, you know?

Doctors fought the bacteria with heavy doses of antibiotics, including vancomycin. But over time, the germs developed resistance and took their toll. I mean, I couldn't use my hands. I couldn't use my feet. I mean, I couldn't even pick up a book to read it. You know, I couldn't, I couldn't do nothing except watch TV. At one point, I couldn't remember how old my son was. I didn't even know what grade he was in. And I just get frustrated. I think, why can't I remember that stuff?

I didn't even know what grade he was in. And I'd get frustrated, I'd think, why can't I remember that stuff? Dr. Henry Freymau, an infectious disease specialist, was trying to figure out why, after six months of antibiotics, Joan was still sick. Lab work showed, besides staph infection, Joan had another bacteria in her system, VRE, or vancomycin-resistant enterococcus. As the name implies, it's already become immune to vancomycin and every other antibiotic. But in Joan's case, the organism made one more unexpected evolutionary leap.

We were flabbergasted by what we saw. What they saw is on this culture plate smeared with Joan's bacteria. A disc of vancomycin is in the middle. And you can see the only place on this plate that the bacteria are growing are around that disc containing the vancomycin. They need that vancomycin in order to multiply. And if they don't have that, they won't grow. So, in a sense, they're using the vancomycin as food. The bacteria not only resist the drug, but have evolved to the point where they thrive on it.

In response, doctors stopped giving Joan vancomycin and the bacteria died. This was the first time ever scientists had seen the new bug, but it won't be the last. Bacteria are really phenomenal and they have an amazing ability to adapt to whatever stresses we inflict upon them. Not only do they develop resistance to antibiotics, they can even find ways to use that antibiotic to help them grow. That adaptability worries scientists. Many believe a death-dealing, all-resistant apocalypse bug is inevitable. I can't see that this problem is going to get better. All that's going to happen is it's going to get worse. The Centers for Disease Control think so too.

They have a special team on standby to race to any emergency. How serious is the war with these organisms? As serious as survival. Microbes have been around for three billion years and we've been around for a lot less time than that. They've shown their ability to survive and adapt to change and the question is whether we can. Coming up on CNN Presents, a mosquito bite that can kill you. How can an everyday pest start an epidemic? The western hemisphere is coming back with the potential to affect the United States. It is called dengue. A severe form of the virus causes internal bleeding and is often fatal.

What's more frightening, it's spread by a mere mosquito bite. Larry Lamont went to Puerto Rico during 1994's dengue epidemic and filed this report. Puerto Rico awakens. Another day of life. Paul, when Rivera sleeps, he is near death. He started with a blood pressure going down, started showing bleeding in his stomach, also his urine turned red. He showed signs that he was getting in shock. His parents watch in disbelief. Two days ago, their healthy son played Power Rangers with his brother. Today he's on life support.

We couldn't get his blood pressure. If we don't get that blood pressure up, he might die. Yes, I understand. The Riveras are told a tiny insect may be responsible. The female Aedes aegypti mosquito can carry a virus known as dengue, an infection of the blood. It's plagued the tropics since the late 1700s. Owen appears to have the most serious dengue. Dengue hemorrhagic fever. Fluid leaks out of the blood, the blood thickens, and the blood pressure plummets. This is my life. This is the first time I've seen a dengue case like this.

Really bad, in really bad condition. Scientists are alarmed. Over the past 15 years in the tropics, outbreaks of dengue fever have become more severe, more widespread, more frequent. Prior to 1981, only one country had reported a diagnosed case of dengue hemorrhagic fever. Today we now are able to indicate that there are 14 or 15 countries in the Americas that have laboratory diagnosed cases of dengue hemorrhagic fever. urbanization of the tropics. Man has invaded enemy territory, giving the mosquito unlimited targets, a perfect setting for epidemics. And man has brought his bad habits with him, helping the mosquito multiply.

With urbanization, you have deteriorating housing, you have inadequate water and sewage lack of solid waste management, garbage piling up. And some of that garbage includes plastic containers and tires filled with fresh rainwater. Ideal incubators for the Aedes aegypti. Puerto Rico was gripped by a dengue epidemic in late 1994. Around 30 cases today. Thousands endured splitting headaches and nausea. Fortunately, most of the cases were mild. Other tropical regions haven't been so lucky. Our concern for the American region specifically is that the severe hemorrhagic form of disease will become epidemic like it has in Southeast Asia.

That's what we're trying to prevent. The efforts to prevent Owen from dying appear to be paying off. On his second day in the hospital, his vital signs have improved. Maybe he'll make it to his fifth birthday party just a week away. Number looks better than two hours ago. He'll get better. Now we're going to do some minor changes and see what happens in the next four hours. Translation, in the next four hours, Alwyn will either live or die. As he struggles, the government also fights back. Spraying makes people feel better, but it's ineffective, because the Aedes aegypti hide under things and often live indoors.

An intense educational campaign is underway, its impact limited. It's door-to-door, in-your-face visits from inspectors that leave the strongest impression, showing residents how they aid and abet the mosquito with open containers. That's how easy it is. Just one open container and you have larvae and mosquitoes. But these visits also reveal how slowly residents change old habits. As mosquito larvae grow on this man's porch, he says he knows little about the problem. He remembers seeing something about it on TV, but was left confused.

This teenager is covered with bites. Does that worry you at all? Not at all. Why not? I don't care about that. The attitude has a price tag. Owen Rivera. We did a checkup of the patient's vital signs, blood pressure normal, normal heart rate, and he was avoiding fine, his oxygenation was okay. So suddenly he was there and he went into cardiac arrest and he never came out, just like that.

Doctors learned later Owen's condition was complicated by a strep infection. Another reason he died only a couple of hours after showing improvement. Owen Rivera is now here. I remember the father saying, there are a lot of criminals going around, drug dealers, killers, that they do fine. They're still alive. Why my kid? Why my kid?

No answer is good enough, but as dengue tightens its grip on the tropics, there will be more Owens. Since we first aired this story last year, the dengue epidemic in Puerto Rico has ended. But last summer a major outbreak in Mexico spilled into southern Texas, Texas causing the first US dengue cases in a decade and experts at the Centers for Disease Control are keeping a lookout for the next outbreak.

tapes.text:
Ronald DeRozier invented the vaccine. We're of course very exhilarated and we quite naturally have these dreams of future success, but this is going to be a vaccine that can save the world. Robert Gallo is co-discoverer of the virus that causes AIDS. He thinks DeRozier's vaccine is too risky. If it's not sufficiently crippled and it replicates significantly the dangers it may cause disease in the person who got the vaccine and it may spread to other people who didn't get the vaccine. DeRozier, a soft-spoken 46-year-old microbiologist, realizes the risk, but everything else he hurled at AIDS fails. We tried a variety of vaccine approaches, including inactivated whole virus, subunit vaccines, recombinant viral vectors, and what we found was failure, failure, failure.

And you've already got, and this will come out in yesterday's writing, we didn't take any time off. Sorry about that for you visitors. And then the Russians came over here, and oh, big sweet write-ups, oh, the Cold War is over and our guys are so superior, they're over here training. Come off it! order of the United Nations in perpetuity, a Russian would head the military army. And we've listed them for you, up to current. So they're already here. The takeover is at hand. They're not communists. They are just soldiers. They don't have the vaguest idea any more than your guys know what the soup they're doing over here.

But it's to bring about the new world order under the United Nations. You can probably get along with them as well as you can get along with your local gendarmes. So let's not panic here. And just in case, I don't want to call it mischief, but there seems like there needs to be somebody willing to get out there and store a little food. But you're not going to be able to do that, are you? Because the new laws say you can't store more than three months supply of food. All the other is subject to confiscation if it's needed. And they don't want you hoarding grain because you're out of grain. And they'll write this in the paper.

There will be no hoarding of grain allowed. But they list their grain and the idiots didn't get on your list. So you're at a crucial critical time. The political conferences are exactly what they appear to be. A rally. It doesn't really mean anything. But with the backing of an unlimited amount of funding in value, you see it's in value, it's in gold value, it can pay the debt. It can just wipe out the debt and it's not a repudiation of debt, it just goes because it will be assigned to the treasury of that nice little States of America United. Forty-eight percent of that document has been set aside for the United States people, but we had to take these contracts and get them done first and they are big and we are giving the bankers half of those contracts to get it done or whoever gets it done and needs some more money. But they're also big enough that they can use their money, keep that for support, and in the fractional banking system, for goodness sakes, 4.8 billion dollars turns into what? Major massive amounts of money. Federal Reserve notes are worth nothing.

And you're not going to get it done in the United States of America because the Federal Reserve has been just printing money. You come in with a debt against the Treasury and the Federal Reserve prints off a lot of new currency notes. And they're getting ready to shut all that down. But the contract is in gold. You can deal with whatever the legal currency is. But the value is in gold. There isn't that much around. There isn't enough money printed around. But the Federal Reserve could certainly print enough to match and meet some of these contracts, but they've not chosen to do that. They think they're going to stonewall. Well, fine. And they may be able to pull it off, but you as citizens should rise up and not let them do it. And I don't mean rise up with your pop They'll just blow you away.

This is the time of serious, serious blowing you away. They don't like me. They don't like the bubble around the tachypnea. You notice they've been trying to blow it away for two days. Rattle your window panes. Well, it isn't going to work. They're going to have to get through me to get you. And I don't bend an iota. And for anyone out there who doesn't want to believe that, don't push your luck. Please, I'm tired of these silly games.

We've worked for 10 years to get here and we're here. And now we can manage what we get. We're not in competition with the United States of America or the world. I wouldn't have it. But we have a mission and you have the tool that could turn your world around. Get control of the money and you can control the world. Will those that get control of the money be any better than the ones who have control of the money now? Not after a while. You can count on it.

And you don't want control of all of it. You want a little bit of it. So we can get on and do our job. And we offer projects, beautiful projects, that can be done in South Africa. But you see, South Africa has to face the fact that the wealth comes from this new world order bunch. And they plan to wipe out the population of the undesirables, you know, having fun. I know it's been slow in coming. Paul, can you? Melissa? Do we have room and everything? We don't? I don't mind if you interrupt.

I don't want to waste a single minute after little Cole gets here. So I'm going to back off. We have a dozen or so seats left. Okay. It's going to be very hard today to keep her separated. So we're just going to have to play it through and tomorrow will be a little easier. She's extremely excited about Little Crow's new approach. I would like to introduce him when he gets here, but I want to tell all of you that Little Crow has made a major, major step. He has cut all ties with everything and anything because this is a year he must go forth and bring those oral traditions and take the word out to the people.

And it's hard. It's hard when you have been barely making it as it is. So let's be very gracious to Little Crow. And I personally ask that he bring some of his materials because when he goes into his lecture series, it's going to be a series of like six weeks. And he will have tapes, which will be the backup for that series of lectures, and I ask him to bring them so that if any of you want to discuss ordering them or getting them and then having them sent or whatever, you would at least have them here. It's a very, very special day, and this marks obviously the New Year, and he wanted to come and speak to you on the importance of these dates and on the prophecies that are coming down as we speak.

And maybe tomorrow I like to use example, and the way that I can use example is to offer you as we meet like this an opportunity to hear together and then sometimes discuss it such things as Tex Marr's interview with Neither one. Jesus is simply a name. That Christed energy is what you're looking for. Get your hand in the hand of that man. And if I sound like a preacher, I hope so, and I don't care what you call him. Jesus is a nice name. His name was, however, Immanuel. And stop biting on this other stuff. If you cannot have, and Tex Mars absolutely accuses face to face, Bogart, for allowing any other kind of spirituality as being one God. No, it's got to be Jesus. Well, every one of you better understand that the head of the Illuminati, the cornerstone, is waiting And that's not my business.

But the world of the evangelists are waiting for something that is not real. And Jesus has become a reality. So accept that reality of this golden light who bears the Christ-ness. You're not going to have a man be able to die for your troubles and your sin. Your salvation comes with you. There is not going to be this wonderful rapture to the clouds. I'm sorry. Who will you go with? How can you go?

So I want to share O'Keele's message please.

tapes.text:
This is called The Law of Giving by Melford O'Keeleau, CFR, President, University of Science and Philosophy, Swannanoa, Box 520, Waynesboro, Virginia, 22980. to understand something very clearly. Because I speak and I recommend and I'm telling you this is truth does not mean that I even remotely agree with the teaching program there. Neither does it mean I disagree with everything that they do there. I am offering you what Chief O'Keele offers you as insight to the work of Walter Russell. And part of my commitment and obligation is to bring Walter Russell's work up here to the world. Because as with everything, as man takes over and makes his decision about whatever, spirituality, non-spirituality, religion, I'm just a better scientist than you, you will get distortions. So let's go with the facts that are, and then all of you can scatter out and go be whatever you want to be.

And allow whatever you want to allow, but knowing you stand responsible. You. I stand responsible for myself. I take responsibility for what I teach you in this room. I am a teacher, I can let you be anything you want to be. That does not mean I sanction it in any way whatsoever. So please, go on. Here is a quote from the divine Iliad. All that ye give shall be given back a hundredfold. Giving means to present voluntarily without expecting compensation. Love means giving, and giving means love. Giving alone does not fulfill the law of love. To comply with the law of love there must be a giving and an equal re-giving. It is the giving and equal re-giving that make up the law of love or the law of balance.

In this world every idea or thing is paired or divided into two, so the universe is composed of twos or pairs of opposites. For example, the idea of giving is divided into giving and re-giving. Action is divided into action and reaction. Man-idea into man and woman. Temperature into cold and heat. Business into selling and buying, and so on. What each unit in each pair does to the other is governed or controlled by the law of love, which is also the law of balance. The law says that each unit borns the other. In other words, in the pair of giving and re-giving, each giving will born its own re-giving. What you give will be returned to you in kind. The law of love compels the re-giving for whatever you give to another person or to the world in general. To fulfill the law of love, the giving and the receiving must be equal and balanced. If the giving and the re-giving are not equal, they cannot unite or balance, and the result shall be unbalanced or a violation of the law of love. Every unbalance violates the law of love and spells disaster. Balance means unity, oneness, satisfaction, ecstasy, joy, equilibrium, equality, stillness, peace, love, truth, happiness, or any action or giving which is capable of good results. Unbalance is the basis of what we call evil, bad, or sin, for example, anger, fear, gossip, cheating, lying, disharmony, inequality, violence, fighting, and so on. Giving is the first great law of the universe. The only thing life can give to you is that which you first give to it. When you give you are fulfilling God's first law. Giving is the secret of love. Even the secret of man's power lies in giving with love. To live love means having no thought of what you are going to get from whatever you may do, but only to think what you can give.

God's new law of love from the message of the divine Iliad says, quote, All that ye give shall be given back a hundredfold. Try it. By giving or serving the world with love and you will tell others this universal truth. God thinks love and gives only love to all his creations. It is man's duty and only key to happiness to emulate God, his creator, and do likewise. The basic law of love. Balanced giving is giving motivated by love or one meant to benefit the receiver or all men, including the giver. By giving love from the soul, one insulates himself from bad influences such as hatreds and fears. Equal Giving and Re-giving. The love cycle of giving and re-giving is the expression of love in the visible universe of motion. If both expressions of the love cycle are equal and balanced with each other, the result is what we call good.

If they are not balanced, all of those things which we call ills, diseases, frustrations, failures, hatreds, and enmities arise from that imbalance. The secret of life is to learn to balance one's transactions with all other men so that our givings and regivings are equal and in balance with each other. The more you give, the more God gives you. The law of equal giving, or for-regiving, is absolute. You must give equally for what is given you. An effort on your part must pay for the effort on God's part. If you stop giving and you shut off, then you will shut off your supply. If the heavens cease giving rains to earth, the earth ceases giving crops and forests which would return moisture to the heavens.

God's law will never give you anything without an equivalent repayment in return. Love means exchange of service for service, and God's law demands that service given must equal service rendered. If man gives more than is expected, God's law will balance it in promotion or increased salary. If that is not a person's motive and if increase is not given him, he has enriched himself by experience and better judgment in the management of his life. The genius who gives his all of great value for less than a materialist has ten thousand times more reward of the kind he wants than the materialist. He has the ecstasy of living in the high heavens. He knows the joy of self-expression of hearing heavenly rhythms which do not exist for the materialist, and his immortality lives forever in the memory of man, while the materialist is forgotten. The genius never counts reward for service in terms of monetary values.

His reward is a satisfaction that all the money in the world could not equal. He will win the gratitude of the world. The world will still be re-giving love for the love he gave to mankind. There are other values than money values, and money values have no meaning whatsoever unless they manifest love. Love action, or giving something to others with love, is a balanced action, which will return to bless the giver. Once you give with love, the law of love itself compels the re-giving of more love from God to you. The more you give, the more you are re-given. God first gives us all the good things of life, parents, children, brothers, sisters, relatives, wealth, employment, health, life, plants, flowers, rivers, oceans, air, and countless things necessary for our existence. This is love given, and God awaits us to re-give him through his children or creatures on earth. We must now re-give all of them to others so that he will continue to re-give us more and more in order that we may continue to give forever.

In this respect, every man and woman is a debtor to the world. We all owe the world. world, if we fail to give, it is debited against us in the universal balance sheet. If we give love, it is credited to our favor in the same balance sheet. There is a spiritual bank for everyone. The moment something is credited or debited in your spiritual bank, it will eventually materialize in your physical world, in your lifetime. The moment we give, the law of love automatically fulfills its part without more prayer. In fact, the act of giving something with love is prayer. If the giving and the re-giving are not equal, the two halves cannot balance. The result will be unbalanced, which violates the law of love. This always brings trouble in man's life or in nature.

Giving is a spiritual quality of mind. The man whose God-awareness has been awakened in him knows how to give selfless service to mankind. He does not take, he does not hoard, he gives or re-gives. The material man in his greed for money, material possessions and power, knows nothing but taking from others. He takes violently or fraudulently, he cheats, lies, gossips, envies, and deceives others to take something from them. The law states, quote, the exercise of might over right by the strong over the weak will strengthen the weak to destroy the strong.

The same law of love further states, quote, what one gives he always has, whether or not he is re-given in kind. The fruits of conforming to the giving principle are love, peace, happiness, inspiration, and exaltation, which come only to those who have become aware of the inner light in them. You either take or give. If you take, you are expressing primitive practices which will react against you. If you give, you are storing up the most valuable attribute anyone can acquire, character, and you are on the spiritual path to self-discovery. Those who give can never be impoverished. They are like unto wells of living waters. The more they have to give, the more God's law of love re-gives them and works for them as it works for the plants and animals. HEADING SELF-PRESERVATION AND TAKING The great deterrent to the peace, happiness, and prosperity of any man is the remaining influence of man's primitive trait, the preoccupation with self-preservation.

His keynote or primitive existence was self-preservation. The method he used was taking and taking anything he wanted from the other man for himself. His desire was for self alone, and that desire is still predominant in most of us. Heading, universal service. The basis of cosmic man's desire is to give him himself for the universal self. In him, the individual self is lost in the desire to give service for the whole of mankind to the exclusion of self, in fact, giving service with utter forgetfulness of self. The keynote of the unfolding cosmic man is the universal self, which means a full realization of the brotherhood of man as one, and of unity with God as one. Man should now learn to lose his own self, to find a universal self. Individualists believe they can acquire by taking. Universalists know they can acquire only by giving. Man must emulate his Creator to give. God always re-gives many times more than that which has been given. All those great events which happen to selfless persons are God sent. God sends to compensate them for the selfless service they have been rendering to mankind. This is God in action. This is what he meant when he said, ìOf a verity I say, no man shall nor rest, until he giveth love of himself to all men.

The giving of good, love, for mutual cooperation, must now be the world-thought keynote of the new humanism if man is to survive. If you seek anything for yourself, for your personal enjoyment, you prevent yourself from getting it. But if you seek it selflessly for the universal self or the public good, then it is given to you at the proper time and place when you are ready or mature enough to handle what you want. It is said that that which is yours will always find you. This is the truth of life. Selfless service leads to self-purification. In the search for the light within, there should be no trace of self-interest. In such a search no one can lose his bearing for long. Immediately if he takes to the wrong path, he stumbles. He may even fall before he is raised and redirected to the original path of truth. Selfless service for the universal self as a whole is the only way to man's personal success.

Love, put into any product, regives love from happy purchasers. Work worthy done, worthily done, in service, given to all the world, and all the world regives it in like measure. The world beats a path to the door of every man who excels in the giving of loving service to his neighbor. Excellence, worthiness, selflessness, and joyfulness, given out by any man echoes in the hearts of all men. The world will find a way to your door if you attract it to you by working with the law. When you love and see goodness and beauty in all things, what is yours will come to you when you are ready for it.

George Washington Carver, the man who talked with the flowers, was described thus, He asked nothing, sought nothing from any man. He lived only to give, to serve, to enrich mankind with his excellence. No one could have been more lowly and obscure, yet the world beat a path to his door and laid garlands of love at his feet. Heading, Conclusion. Every person is a font of living waters which must ever flow to keep him ever living. He who shuts off the fountains of his abundant self, stagnates the living waters of his living self and contaminates all things with his very breathing. He who withholds his giving, deprives himself alone of the gifts of his desiring.

The great lesson of life is the need of giving out from the abundance of oneself in order to be ever abundant within oneself. He who gives abundantly will be served with abundance, and he who gives more of service than has been asked of him will multiply within himself that which he has ever given by increasing his capacity for giving. Love cannot be possessed. Therefore, ask not for love, but give it. When you give, do not give grudgingly, give with love. He who giveth love prospereth mightily, but he who taketh ought gaineth not. The love principle of giving, which dominates the God mind, will rule the world in the coming cosmic age instead of the hate principle of taking. We are finding that the seed grown through our practice of taking is reaped in the harvest of lust and hate from that which crime springs.

We are also going to find that the practice of the love principle gives us intense happiness and a power that we never dreamed of before. The practice of the love principle is seeping into the world and we shall see much of the effects of it in our civilization. Here's a poem that says, Speak to us of giving. And he answered, You give but little when you give of your possessions. It is when you give of yourself that you truly give. There are those who give with joy, and that joy is their reward. And there are those who give with pain, and that pain is their baptism, and there are those who have little and give it all. And I believe I see little Crow in our door. Welcome little Crow. And I have...

I'll hold it right here. I have two paragraphs to go and we'll finish it. And there are those who have little and give it all. There are believers in life and bounty of life, and their coffers are never empty. They give that they may live, for to withhold is to perish. It is well to give when asking, but it is better to give unasked through understanding, and to the open-handed the search for one who shall receive his joy greater than giving. Therefore give now, that the reason for giving may be yours and not your inheritor's. That was from the prophet by Cahil de Brane. Only actual practice of faith, hope and love, seven days in a week, backed by the Ten Commandments, will enable man and his world to rise above the clouds of self-created fears, reaching for the light of understanding among all races and creeds.

And that was by Anonymous, whoever he is. He gets around. And that is the end of the writing from Dr. Malford Okino. Now see how well we plan. Perfect. Greetings, little girl. We have a place reserved for you. Right there. You teeny little fellow, you see what electricity there is. So good to see you. Good to see you. Well, I have some material that if you'll let me know where to put it later we will have them do that they're just kind of waiting to get there on the road that are they out there now yes they are may I go bring them in you sure me all you do make this thing work David I'll turn this back This is the on button, and when you're not using it, if you turn it down, then it saves the juice.

Am I supposed to talk now? No. Oh, okay. This is very formal. Very, very formal. I'm not even letting her out of her cage. It's a special day. It's a special time. And we have friends, Little Crow, who have come from Canada, from everywhere. We're starting. We're ending a decade. We're starting on Hardball now. of you who have struggled along with us are going to witness also little crow taking on his greater flight wings, his feathers. Man has got to come back into his realization with a greater being, which is himself connected with that which is the great spirit of the universe.

And I'm not going to take another minute of his time, just 30 seconds of it. He's capable of expressing himself. We met many years ago, many, many years ago for me. He came at the time of the Convergence. It was a special time then, it is a more special time now. And I figure that he can catch up from the tape. And I think that you gentlemen who do the taping may want to start a new tape so that little crow has it for his own purposes. He is blessing you with one of his first lectures from his series. And this man is going to go out now and struggle in that world trying to reach through to people to awaken them a little bit. And his biggest problem is going to be his own people as always his fact. They drift away, they become tainted by this world. And they've had a hard, hard road to walk.

So you start from a long way back, but I'm telling you, everybody listen to me carefully. The ancients hosted you, brought you here, and the ancients will take you home. And it's up to you whether you stay in that canoe or get tipped over. Because ain't nobody going to save you. Nobody except yourself. We have brought forth and pointed the way. You have the resources. God has made sure you have them. It's up to you what you do with them. And this is a special day and I thank you for coming. Now, Karen says this is a speaking stick, a talking stick.

Then I have shut up. So I guess I'll just give it to you, little croak. Pilama, Pilama Waste. Thank you. Thank you. So as long as I have this in my vicinity, I can speak, I guess. I'm not good at holding things, preferably not good at holding my tongue. You came to use your tongue. Did you want this back? No. The rules, you have to understand, the rules apply to everybody. Thank you very much. Glad you clarified that. That's one of my big things. Thank you Commander and all of you for, how far has everybody come from? Is anybody from out of state? You see your hand. Is anybody from where? Just kind of let me know. West Virginia.

tapes.text:
There are certain areas in which to start and one of them is called the Wolaka. The Wolaka is essentially a story and the short story in about two minutes is about who I am. Though I am Little Crow, I was someone else before that by the name of Carl Bryant. Carl died in 1990, 91, somewhere in there. And that opened the door for Little Crow, which is a kind of a family name carried by my grandfather, my father, and my great-grandfather, all having other names. And my other name, my real name is Teyat Teytuda, which means his Red Nation. I died in 1863 on July 3rd and was reborn and re-entered into this environment on July 8th, 1933. Now that doesn't seem like a very significant date, but as we proceed here, the rest of this time that I have with you and as we watch the video that I'm going to share with you here, it will make some sense to you, at least it makes sense to me and I've always been of the mind that faith is kind of a strange thing, even if no one else in the entire universe agrees with you, faith is what you are about as an individual and that in itself is enough. You don't really need the concurrence or validation of another human being of any sort, but if you do truly believe that and live in that way, then it is of great benefit to the universe and to all things to which we are connected.

Born in Pine Ridge, South Dakota and was raised by a woman from the Rosebud. Grew up in the environment of the Midwest, Omaha, Nebraska and from there entered into military service, government service and kind of wandered the world and wound up out here California and came under the tutelage and advice of five elders when I was age 39 after a lot of self-destructive attitude and behavior, self-hatred of myself mainly which I perpetrated upon people of different status and color working for the federal government at that in the areas of drug enforcement. So it became kind of an interesting transition going back into my culture at age 39 re-having to establish myself and to do all the things which were required of me to do and continue to do that on a day to day basis now from 39 to 63 and learning to be who I am, to be who I am and what I am.

And so that's the story. I am an Iska, I'm an interpreter of my oral tradition. And as in all interpretations, interpretations hinge on perspective. And perspectives are individual. Each of us in this room have a perspective and so we have maybe 80 perspectives in here that here's one thing, and we have 80 different interpretations of what we hear. And so as we can realize that and apply that to the universe and to those things which have been our history over the many ages, it begins to make sense as to why there has not been an agreement or coming to a consensus just because of that issue itself.

That each of us bears our own perspective and even though we enjoy ourselves in a common cause it is very difficult for us at times to reach consensus without a feeling of being slighted or our opinions are meaningless or have no power or have no authority. And so it's very difficult to have a group of any kind or a community of any kind that can operate with the idea that community is indeed what we are and that we are accountable and connected and related and in that relatedness we are responsible for those with whom we exist and that includes the planet. So it was with that in keeping that I say to you today I do not speak for Little Crow. These words are mine, they are my perspective about what you will see, what we'll share with you today. And in doing that, I would hope that you are mindful of that as you listen to me as we talk about these things which I've brought here, as I say, to share with you.

That in itself is kind of the crutch of it. It is always an honor and a pleasure to come up this way and to be with my dear friends E.J. and Doris and the commander and to be in this area. It's a beautiful area here. And as some of you know and you've heard of me and read of me and others of you I don't and I would look forward to shaking your hands and meeting you today. Handshakes are $7.50. LAUGHTER Pictures with the King are $25. LAUGHTER A long time ago I figured if Sitting Bull could do that, then I could too. He used to charge for his photos and also black elk. So, you know, that's how it goes. But it's been an interesting adventure for me and as I say it is something that I wish to share. We have a gathering down in Orange County and it's called the American Indian Unity Church and we refer to it as a gathering and it is trademarked and for those who are from Colorado we do not have a satellite in Colorado although I recognize that in Boulder someone is calling themselves the American Indian Unity Church and they will be hearing from my attorneys. You got to protect that stuff. You see educated Indian that makes it really kind of tough sometimes when you get educated Indian. You think that the pain of birthing, and that's what we're doing, going into a new time. It isn't coming. It is here, and it's operational, and we're in it. It's not something that's going to happen next week. It's here. It's been happening since 1987, and as Casey said, since 58. It's been going on. So we're in that process, and we, like every other nation of people, are struggling with the same kinds of problems. It isn't that Indians en masse are wonderful and loving and spiritual and knowledgeable. It's just that there are few who are wonderful and loving and spiritual and knowledgeable and the rest of them are like everybody else, confused and frustrated and angry and flailing, flailing around, you know, in the atmosphere trying to find stability.

And so we have to break that romanticized idea and get into the reality of it that all of us then have to be able to present this message, not just indigenous people, because you're all accountable to our own condition. Each one of you have contributed to the conditions of the world today, and you have to be accountable for it and start to live our lives in such a way that it isn't left up to one people. It's not left up to the black race or the red race or the yellow race or the white race, it's left up to the human race to be accountable for the conditions and to make the changes which are necessary in the world today, in the planet today, in the universe today. There's no special group. We're just saying these things because we remembered it longer and sooner that we've tried to live ourselves in this way and we've not been able to do it. If it's such a damn good way, we should have been able to be at the apex of our existence rather than at the cellar and shit rolls downhill. You know, we're the poorest people in the world in some instances and now we're becoming the richest people in the world because we finally have said there is a way here in which to make the money. There is a way here in which to become independent and to become self-sustaining and to recapture our dignity.

But even above all of that, I'm saying to them, before you do any of that and think that as the Savior of the salvation, you have got to recapture your spirituality, which means you've got to be who you are. Each and every one of us has to be who we are. And it can't be religiosity or party politics or economy or whatever. It has to be that we are human beings, human beings. And it is our place and our purpose here to serve in the work of the Creator. And that is to love, to share, to have bravery, to have fortitude, establish community, to work and be accountable for our process here. And you know what our process here is, is breathing. We're here to breathe like the trees and the rocks. We're here to act as filters for the air. We breathe the air in and you store the toxicity in your body. That's why your body ages. That's why things grow in your body. That's why your body gets sick.

Your mind doesn't get sick, your body gets sick. And it's because we're storehousing and warehousing all the toxicity in the air. And we try to eliminate it by the natural cycle and that works sometimes but for the most part we have not been able to find a way to eliminate the toxicity and the pollutants in our body that we take in. And it is the same problem we are faced with when we're talking about nuclear fuel rods, nuclear waste, toxic waste. We cannot find any place to put it or any way to eliminate it. And so it has overwhelmed us and it is taking its toll. Because it must coexist also and it has a right to coexist. And we are the ones who have created it. All of us by allowing it to happen, wanting better ways of electricity, better ways to have power, better ways to have a comfortable home, better, bigger cars to drive, faster automobiles, faster computers. We have technologically put ourselves out of existence and the machines are running our lives. And we'll do so until we come to the birthing time and this thing shuts down.

And you won't hit that switch and nothing will come on. You won't pick up the phone, there'll be no way to talk. You have to learn smoke signals. We'll be back to that, you see, we'll be back to that. But our purpose is not to lead us out of it, but is to share with you that we are all equally spiritual. We are all equally accountable for what it is we have seen and watched and contributed to, and we must find a way for us to come to that sense of thinking. Chuck talked about the blue star, the blue star Kachina. We talk about also in the Lakota, the red and blue days where things turn. The moon becomes red and the sun becomes blue. What that is, you know what that is, simplicity? You know what it is? It's a reduction of our ego. It's a reduction of our egotism. Our ego needs to reduce itself and our humility needs to increase. And we talk about the red and blue times simply as a metaphor for breathing. Each breath I take in between I die. Each new breath gives me new life, a new beginning, in the hoop, in the circle. With each breath I exhale, I reduce my ego to the experience of death, and for each new breath I take I increase my humility. And what's it all about? Compassion. We wish God to have compassion, we wish the host of heavens to be compassionate, and what do we know about compassion? Compassion is realizing through experience, through lifetime after lifetime after lifetime, that we can not understand, but that we can accept the problems that another human being is going through.

If we were to understand anything, we would have created parity and equality for women a thousand years ago. So obviously we don't understand that. You see, what we try to do now is to say, then, let's have...

And Tom very graciously began to send his original drawings to me. So we have them, and when the quarrel is over, we will have better books. They are the least important because the information is, after all, available, and there is nothing they can do to prevent us from correcting the errors. Nothing. And we can use little vignettes. Certainly there is no law that says we cannot mention the name of a scientist of that magnitude.

If they are going to recognize him as a leading scientist, then they can't keep that information forever. But the lovely part of all of this is the way it should have been done in the first place. We should have had this allowance, and that is working with the ones at the head of that institute, and I call it an institute, it's no more a university than this room. This is a better one. They have turned the Russell Foundation into a metaphysical bunch of, you go over and meditate and you get in touch with your higher power and all of those wonderful things. They call themselves New Age.

You'd have to go back and read Nora's writings about the Russells and Lowell's family line and all of this. They're all hooked in with England through the Tavistock Institute and Brookings Institute, which is a branch of the Tavistock Institute handling mind control and religious studies of this New Age group. Well of course they don't want Walter Russell's material out the way we would present it. But Russell had already put it out. And they copyrighted it. They did him in. He gave his things to Duke University, I believe. Princeton maybe. He scattered them actually.

foundation that took over. Remember, Russell remarried in his elder years. A much younger woman, Lyle's much younger. And I do not put Lyle Russell down. Her ideas of meditation, etc., apparently matched his, but I don't think that his wife of a zillion years really appreciated it. And I don't think it was responsible on his part to treat his human existence like that. And certainly he was more spiritual during his development of these theories. And the gift that he was given, this man could do, he was a sculptor, he was an architect, he was everything.

And yet things were missing in his life. Lao came along, this beautiful woman, and he was captivated. They had much in common. And he had been a part of the elite societies. Come off it! This was not a, oh my goodness, I'm born of God today. This man grew in his spiritual understanding. And he was given these great gifts and he never intended to hide them. Nikola, as in Tesla, told him, Walter, it's not time. I tried and I'm telling you Walter, it isn't time. The world is not ready for it and I have had to put mine away. And you will have to put yours away. Man is not ready for this. And surely enough man was not ready for it. The Russell Foundation was then taken by Lao. They bought this palace, Suvarnabhumi, and turned it into a temple.

You can call it anything you want. But basically it then became a temple to Lao, still using this Russell air about it. And she was a beautiful, beautiful woman, with grace, with poise, with all of the things. This is the way things get sidetracked. Now what happened? Timothy Binder, nice, I believe he's a chiropractor, I believe he's a naturopath. And he travels. He was a nice guy. Well, without giving a very close name to all of you, he's the one who turned George Green in.

Nobody was after Dorma. America West Publishers, George Green was abrupt. The reason that anybody mentioned it to Timothy Binder. And then it began to really fall apart. And George did all the wrong things, but he thought he could get in there and work it out with Timothy. I want to tell you, he still owes all that money that he bargained for. Timothy's out. He travels and he teaches healing and other things. He's still on the board of directors. But guess what? And comes from, again, Africa. Left Tom Masley over there.

He doesn't even know it, but this Melford O'Keele, Okilo, chief of one of those states, the river state of Nigeria. We got along with him just fine, just fine. We use his material, he is appreciative, he wants to work out whatever can be worked out so we can work together. in this man's life and is to get the truth of light and God out. And we can work together with Walter Russell's material. We don't have to go over and do whatever they're doing. And this is one reason they were offended. I refuse to use anything out of their study courses that Lau had conjured, because it's not real.

It is not real. And people may not like it, I'm sorry. However, if you want to go over there, go over there. It is a marvelous experience. Use discernment, weed out whatever it is you don't want any part of, and enjoy the other. But when you listen to O'Keele, he is telling you exactly what was just told to you the last two days and he is a black man with a whole different perspective coming out of the depths of Nigeria, Africa. It's going to get there people.

Yes. went to the palace and It is indeed focused mainly on Lao heavy in Masonic trappings Somewhat in disrepair beautiful anyway, but very dark We only had a few minutes, but we shot some video and we'll we'll send them back to the group if you're interested We're interested. Yes it because it's a curiosity now Okay, that's all we had an interesting thing happen. Really basically neighbors of Swannanoa.

You had to pass these people's home down the road. And they saw Prince Charles and his entourage going there. This had been maybe three years ago, possibly four. The person with whom we had the most contact went with this other party. And they went to Swarna Palace and looked at the grounds. There was a pentagram at the foot of the Christ of the Mountains. And then there was a tower around in the back with a plank off of it. And obviously a barbecue or something had been at the bottom. A lot of the outer buildings were in total disrepair. And these things were mentioned.

It was that these people had been there, had gone inside, and they had the same expression that you just said. It seemed heavy and dark. And they felt really uncomfortable in there. The gardens were gorgeous, and they were able to walk around outside in the gardens and so forth. But commented on these things. And verbatim, from the letter that was sent. We just wrote it in the paper. It's interesting what Timothy Binder did.

He wrote a rebuffal. Now, I didn't send it to contact. He published it in his newsletter or whoever's, George Green's I believe, and Bogreit's. And he denied that there were satanic rituals and no one was sacrificed or committed suicide off of that tower. Well, at that point, a tower as such was not mentioned. A platform or something was mentioned because it was a water tower, had a water tank at one time. I don't know what's there. I haven't looked.

Not interested. They immediately went out and they changed the pentagram to a six-star. Why bother? Why bother? And why make a big damn deal of it? And they never heard of Brookings Institute. And they, let's see, I believe that they had looked up and there was a Steinberger burger something on the board. And back came a rebuttal that said, well we don't happen to have a Jew on the board now. And we have never had this one or that one on the board.

Not that we would object. Just because we have no blacks, Jews, you know, only skinheads, what are we trying to say here? Ku Klux Klan? What are we trying to say here? If you are a Mason and you go down to the local Masonic lodge and you play with the guys and you're proud of being a Mason, what difference does it make? Wouldn't you plant a garden maybe with a star in it or a... What is this? It's what they do with it that you can always tell. What do they deny? What is this? And I still say that you can be president of something and chairman of the board and very possibly you don't know that Brookings Institute is paying your bills. They're pretty good at covering things up, but what difference? And certainly no royalty, they said, was on their board. Well, I guess Prince Charles is no longer considered royalty. I don't know. He was there. And they would be very proud if he had visited. Well, why weren't they very proud? He was seen there. Why the big denial? Why the big denial?

Wouldn't you think if something like Brookings Institute was funding you, you'd be kind of pleased about it, if nothing else than the funding? The facts are MI6, which is Her Majesty's secret service, private service, runs the place. Dead. And why do you think there is an African there now? They are trying their very best to work it out so they're not caught in their own trap. And they think they can control O'Keele, but they won't be able to because he's got the light. And maybe he will do whatever they want to do because that probably was the agreement. So he may not stay long, he will be there long enough.

And they're having trouble in Africa. They plan to turn Africa, they already are doing it. They're killing off the people. All the blacks, the unwanted they call them. All the unwanted. Now isn't it interesting that Africa is basically, supposedly a black nation and they're going to kill off the blacks? Except for quote the servants, the miners and so forth. Have you ever heard anything so absurd? Not since the East India Company. All this is England. All this is Great Britain. And they're always able to buy. To buy. Now, is the money bad? Or the people? This is genocide we're talking about. This is worse than Kevorkian. My God, you're side and they've done it. Ebola? Come on. It is murder. Well they ain't going to wipe them out. They made one big bad, bad, bad blunder. They brought them to America as slaves.

And when they get sick of the way they have been treated, it will be a bloodbath. Because they're passionate about it. And I'm going to be hard put not to help them. A bloodbath in America, Commander? Yes. Can I ask another question? Yes. Changing the subject a little bit to another continent.

tapes.excerpt: At the readings on from Lanto the sage and his association with Buddha and I noticed Teddy has an experience with an Indian master And I was wondering if you could comment on the the art of war by Sun Tzu and if he was playing at present some part in the in this overall strategy to raise the Raise and purify the consciousness of the planet and maybe if this is not the appropriate time to respond to that if sometime in the future writings if you could I'd rather do the latter.
